current_target as (

changed_keys as (

    select
        
        s.ENTITY,
        
        s.CHANNEL_CD,
        
        s.SUBCHANNEL_CD
        
    from source_data s
    inner join current_target t
        on s.ENTITY = t.ENTITY and s.CHANNEL_CD = t.CHANNEL_CD and s.SUBCHANNEL_CD = t.SUBCHANNEL_CD

    where
        
        s.CHANNEL_GRP is distinct from t.CHANNEL_GRP or 
        
        s.CHANNEL_DESC is distinct from t.CHANNEL_DESC or 
        
        s.SUBCHANNEL_GRP is distinct from t.SUBCHANNEL_GRP or 
        
        s.SRC_SYSTEM is distinct from t.SRC_SYSTEM
        

),

rows_to_close as (

    select
        t.SCD_ROW_KEY,
        
        t.ENTITY,
        
        t.CHANNEL_CD,
        
        t.SUBCHANNEL_CD,
        
        
        t.CHANNEL_GRP,
        
        t.CHANNEL_DESC,
        
        t.SUBCHANNEL_GRP,
        
        t.SRC_SYSTEM,
        
        t.VALID_FROM,
        current_timestamp()::timestamp_ntz   as VALID_TO,
        false as IS_ACTIVE,
        t.BATCH_ID,
        t.DBT_INVOCATION_ID,        
        t.JOB_ID,
        t.LOAD_TS

    from current_target t
    inner join changed_keys c
        on t.ENTITY = c.ENTITY and t.CHANNEL_CD = c.CHANNEL_CD and t.SUBCHANNEL_CD = c.SUBCHANNEL_CD

),

rows_to_insert as (

    select
        hash(coalesce(s.ENTITY::string, ''), coalesce(s.CHANNEL_CD::string, ''), coalesce(s.SUBCHANNEL_CD::string, ''), coalesce(s.SOURCE_DATA_CREATED_AT::string, '')) as SCD_ROW_KEY,
        
        s.ENTITY,
        
        s.CHANNEL_CD,
        
        s.SUBCHANNEL_CD,
        
        
        s.CHANNEL_GRP,
        
        s.CHANNEL_DESC,
        
        s.SUBCHANNEL_GRP,
        
        s.SRC_SYSTEM,
        
        s.SOURCE_DATA_CREATED_AT as VALID_FROM,
        cast(null as timestamp_ntz) as VALID_TO,
        true as IS_ACTIVE,

        on s.ENTITY = t.ENTITY and s.CHANNEL_CD = t.CHANNEL_CD and s.SUBCHANNEL_CD = t.SUBCHANNEL_CD

        or (

        ) in (
            select ENTITY, CHANNEL_CD, SUBCHANNEL_CD
            from changed_keys
        )

),

final as (

    select * from rows_to_close
    union all
    select * from rows_to_insert
    qualify row_number() over (partition by SCD_ROW_KEY order by IS_ACTIVE asc) = 1
        -- kalau SCD_ROW_KEY bentrok (edge case: 2 perubahan di hari sama

        -- akan otomatis diperlakukan sebagai "belum sempat di-close",
        -- tapi versi barunya tetap benar. Ini pengaman terakhir, BUKAN
        -- pengganti fix akar masalah (lihat CATATAN #6 di bawah)
)

WITH DATE_RANGE AS (
        SELECT
            DATEADD(
                DAY,
                SEQ4(),
                TO_DATE('1980-01-01')
            ) AS DATE
        FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => 43829))
    ),
     
    BASE AS (
        SELECT
            HASH(
                'YOUR_SRC_SYSTEM',
                TO_CHAR(DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
            ) AS DIFF_HK,
     
            TO_CHAR(DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS PERIOD_KEY,
            DATE,
     
            /* Sunday = 1 ... Saturday = 7 */
            MOD(DAYOFWEEKISO(DATE), 7) + 1 AS DAY_OF_WEEK,
     
            DAYNAME(DATE) AS DAY_NM_OF_WEEK,
            DAYOFMONTH(DATE) AS DAY_OF_MTH,
            DAYOFYEAR(DATE) AS DAY_OF_YR,
     
            MONTHNAME(DATE) AS MTH_NM,
            MONTH(DATE) AS MTH_OF_YR,
            QUARTER(DATE) AS CALENDAR_QUARTER,
     
            CASE
                WHEN MONTH(DATE) <= 6 THEN 1
                ELSE 2
            END AS CALENDAR_SEMESTER,
     
            YEAR(DATE) AS CALENDAR_YR,
     
            CASE
                WHEN DAYNAME(DATE) NOT IN ('Sat', 'Sun') AND CALENDAR_YR < 2003 THEN 1
                WHEN CALENDAR_YR >= 2003 AND DAYNAME(DATE) NOT IN ('Sat', 'Sun') THEN 1
                WHEN CALENDAR_YR >= 2003 AND HOL.HOLIDAY_DT IS NOT NULL THEN 0
                ELSE 0
            END AS IS_WORK_DAY,
     
            CASE
                WHEN DAYNAME(DATE) NOT IN ('Sat', 'Sun') THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END AS IS_WEEK_DAY,
     
            TO_CHAR(DATE, 'YYYYMM') AS MTH_KEY,
     
            TO_CHAR(
                DATEADD(MONTH, -1, DATE),
                'YYYYMM'
            ) AS PREV_MTH_KEY
     
        FROM DATE_RANGE D
     
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_RLS.HOLIDAY HOL
            ON D.DATE = to_date(to_varchar(HOL.HOLIDAY_DT))
    )
    
     
    ,WD AS (
        SELECT
            B.*,
     
            CASE
                WHEN IS_WORK_DAY = 1 THEN
                    COUNT_IF(IS_WORK_DAY = 1) OVER (
                        ORDER BY DATE
                        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
                        AND CURRENT ROW
                    )
            END AS WORK_DAY_ALL,
     
            CASE
                WHEN IS_WORK_DAY = 1 THEN
                    COUNT_IF(IS_WORK_DAY = 1) OVER (
                        PARTITION BY MTH_KEY
                        ORDER BY DATE
                        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
                        AND CURRENT ROW
                    )
            END AS WORK_DAY_OF_MTH
     
        FROM BASE B
    )
     
    ,WD_PREV AS (
        SELECT
            W.*,
     
            CASE
                WHEN IS_WORK_DAY = 1 THEN
                    LAG(WORK_DAY_OF_MTH) IGNORE NULLS OVER (
                        ORDER BY DATE
                    )
            END AS PREV_DAY_WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,
     
            CASE
                WHEN IS_WORK_DAY = 1 THEN
                    LAG(PERIOD_KEY) IGNORE NULLS OVER (
                        ORDER BY DATE
                    )
            END AS PREV_DAY_WORK_DAY_PERIOD_KEY,
     
            MAX(WORK_DAY_OF_MTH) OVER (
                PARTITION BY PREV_MTH_KEY
            ) AS MAX_PREV_MTH_WORK_DAY_OF_MTH
     
        FROM WD W
    )
     
    ,WD_FINAL AS (
        SELECT
            W.*,
     
            CASE
                WHEN IS_WORK_DAY = 1 THEN
                    LEAST(
                        WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,
                        MAX_PREV_MTH_WORK_DAY_OF_MTH
                    )
            END AS PREV_MTH_WORK_DAY_OF_MTH
     
        FROM WD_PREV W
    )
     
    ,WD_WITH_PREV_MTH AS (
        SELECT
            P.*,
     
            PM.PERIOD_KEY AS PREV_MTH_WORK_DAY_PERIOD_KEY
     
        FROM WD_FINAL P
     
        LEFT JOIN WD_FINAL PM
            ON PM.MTH_KEY = P.PREV_MTH_KEY
            AND PM.IS_WORK_DAY = 1
            AND PM.WORK_DAY_OF_MTH = P.PREV_MTH_WORK_DAY_OF_MTH
    )
     
    SELECT
        DIFF_HK,
        PERIOD_KEY,
        DATE,
        DAY_OF_WEEK,
        DAY_NM_OF_WEEK,
        DAY_OF_MTH,
        DAY_OF_YR,
        MTH_NM,
        MTH_OF_YR,
        CALENDAR_QUARTER,
        CALENDAR_SEMESTER,
        CALENDAR_YR,
        IS_WORK_DAY,
        IS_WEEK_DAY,
        MTH_KEY,
        PREV_MTH_KEY,
        WORK_DAY_ALL,
        WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,
        PREV_DAY_WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,
        PREV_MTH_WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,
        PREV_DAY_WORK_DAY_PERIOD_KEY,
        PREV_MTH_WORK_DAY_PERIOD_KEY,
     
        CASE
            WHEN WORK_DAY_OF_MTH BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 1
            WHEN WORK_DAY_OF_MTH BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN 2
            WHEN WORK_DAY_OF_MTH BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN 3
            WHEN WORK_DAY_OF_MTH BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN 4
            WHEN WORK_DAY_OF_MTH BETWEEN 21 AND 25 THEN 5
        END AS WEEK_WORKING_DAY,
     
        CASE
            WHEN WORK_DAY_OF_MTH BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN 'p1'
            WHEN WORK_DAY_OF_MTH BETWEEN 6 AND 10 THEN 'p2'
            WHEN WORK_DAY_OF_MTH BETWEEN 11 AND 15 THEN 'p3'
            WHEN WORK_DAY_OF_MTH BETWEEN 16 AND 25 THEN 'p4'
        END AS WEEK_WORKING_DAY_SALES
     
    FROM WD_WITH_PREV_MTH
    ORDER BY DATE

with SOURCE_POLICY as (
    
    SELECT
        T3.MDM_ID
        ,T2.PARTY_ROLE_CD as MDM_CUST_ROLE
        ,CASE 
            WHEN T1.ENTITY_CD = 'LIAM' THEN 'RLS'
            WHEN T1.ENTITY_CD = 'G4IAM' THEN 'G400'
            WHEN T1.ENTITY_CD = 'CIAM' THEN 'CLP'
            WHEN T1.ENTITY_CD = 'DPIAM' THEN 'DPLK'
            WHEN T1.ENTITY_CD = 'MIAM' THEN 'MSM'
            END as MDM_CHANNEL
        ,'POLICY' as MDM_POLICY_TYPE
        ,T1.POLICY_NO
        ,T3.BIRTH_DT as CUST_DOB
        ,T3.GENDER_CD as CUST_GENDER_CD
        ,TRIM(
            CONCAT(
                REGEXP_REPLACE(T3.FIRST_NM, '[~,@#$%&*().]', ''),
                ' ',
                REGEXP_REPLACE(T3.LAST_NM, '[~,@#$%&*().]', '')
            )
        ) as CUST_NM
        ,T3.ANNUAL_INCOME_AMT as CUST_ANNUAL_INCOME_AMT
        ,'Manual' AS SRC_SYSTEM
        ,
    '20260916'::VARCHAR AS BATCH_DT,
    '207ed2a4-922e-49c4-b0c2-0ffda55b77c3'::VARCHAR AS DBT_INVOCATION_ID,
    'SLV_POLICY_DIM_MDM_POL'::VARCHAR AS JOB_ID,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()::TIMESTAMP_NTZ(6) AS LOAD_TS

    FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.ENGINE.C_B_POLICY T1
    INNER JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.ENGINE.C_B_PARTY_ROLE_POLICY T2 ON T1.ROWID_OBJ = T2.ROWID_POLICY
    INNER JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.ENGINE.C_B_PARTY T3 ON T2.ROWID_PARTY = T3.ROWID_OBJECT
)

, SOURCE_APPLICATION as (
    
    SELECT
        T3.MDM_ID
        ,T2.PARTY_ROLE_CD as MDM_CUST_ROLE
        ,CASE 
            WHEN T1.ENTITY_CD = 'LIAM' THEN 'RLS'
            WHEN T1.ENTITY_CD = 'G4IAM' THEN 'G400'
            WHEN T1.ENTITY_CD = 'CIAM' THEN 'CLP'
            WHEN T1.ENTITY_CD = 'DPIAM' THEN 'DPLK'
            WHEN T1.ENTITY_CD = 'MIAM' THEN 'MSM'
            END as MDM_CHANNEL
        ,'APPLICATION' as MDM_POLICY_TYPE
        ,T1.APPL_NO as POLICY_NO
        ,T3.BIRTH_DT as CUST_DOB
        ,T3.GENDER_CD as CUST_GENDER_CD
        ,TRIM(
            CONCAT(
                REGEXP_REPLACE(T3.FIRST_NM, '[~,@#$%&*().]', ''),
                ' ',
                REGEXP_REPLACE(T3.LAST_NM, '[~,@#$%&*().]', '')
            )
        ) as CUST_NM
        ,T3.ANNUAL_INCOME_AMT as CUST_ANNUAL_INCOME_AMT
        ,'Manual' AS SRC_SYSTEM
        ,
    '20260916'::VARCHAR AS BATCH_DT,
    '207ed2a4-922e-49c4-b0c2-0ffda55b77c3'::VARCHAR AS DBT_INVOCATION_ID,
    'SLV_POLICY_DIM_MDM_POL'::VARCHAR AS JOB_ID,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()::TIMESTAMP_NTZ(6) AS LOAD_TS

    FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.ENGINE.C_B_APPLICATION T1
    INNER JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.ENGINE.C_B_PARTY_ROLE_POLICY T2 ON T1.APPL_NO = T2.ROWID_OBJECT
    INNER JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.ENGINE.C_B_PARTY T3 ON T2.ROWID_PARTY = T3.ROWID_OBJECT
    LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.ENGINE.C_B_POLICY T4 ON T4.POLICY_NO = T1.APPL_NO AND T4.ENTITY_CD = T3.ENTITY_CD
    LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.ENGINE.C_B_POLICY PLC ON PLC.POLICY_NO = T1.APPL_NO
    WHERE PLC.POLICY_NO IS NULL
)

--   2. Baris PALING TERAKHIR file HARUS `select * from final`
--      (nama CTE `final` di-generate OTOMATIS oleh macro, JANGAN didefinisikan

with source_data as (
    
    SELECT 
        ENTITY_CD as ENTITY_CD
        ,SRC_SYSTEM as DATA_SRC_SYSTEM
        ,PROCESS_TYPE as PROCESS_TYPE
        ,IS_GROSS as IS_GROSS
        ,'RLS' as SRC_SYSTEM
        ,LOAD_TS as SOURCE_DATA_CREATED_AT
    FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_MAN.PROCESSTYPE_GROSS
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SRC_SYSTEM,ENTITY_CD,DATA_SRC_SYSTEM,PROCESS_TYPE ORDER BY LOAD_TS DESC) = 1
),








    

    

    

    





    

    

    

    





current_target as (

    select *
    from AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.DIM_PROCESSTYPE_GROSS
    where IS_ACTIVE = true

),

changed_keys as (

    select
        
        s.SRC_SYSTEM,
        
        s.ENTITY_CD,
        
        s.DATA_SRC_SYSTEM,
        
        s.PROCESS_TYPE
        
    from source_data s
    inner join current_target t
        on s.SRC_SYSTEM = t.SRC_SYSTEM and s.ENTITY_CD = t.ENTITY_CD and s.DATA_SRC_SYSTEM = t.DATA_SRC_SYSTEM and s.PROCESS_TYPE = t.PROCESS_TYPE

    where
        
        s.IS_GROSS is distinct from t.IS_GROSS
        

),

rows_to_close as (

    select
        t.SCD_ROW_KEY,
        
        t.SRC_SYSTEM,
        
        t.ENTITY_CD,
        
        t.DATA_SRC_SYSTEM,
        
        t.PROCESS_TYPE,
        
        
        t.IS_GROSS,
        
        t.VALID_FROM,
        current_timestamp()::timestamp_ntz   as VALID_TO,
        false as IS_ACTIVE,
        t.BATCH_ID,
        t.DBT_INVOCATION_ID,        
        t.JOB_ID,
        t.LOAD_TS

    from current_target t
    inner join changed_keys c
        on t.SRC_SYSTEM = c.SRC_SYSTEM and t.ENTITY_CD = c.ENTITY_CD and t.DATA_SRC_SYSTEM = c.DATA_SRC_SYSTEM and t.PROCESS_TYPE = c.PROCESS_TYPE

),

rows_to_insert as (

    select
        hash(coalesce(s.SRC_SYSTEM::string, ''), coalesce(s.ENTITY_CD::string, ''), coalesce(s.DATA_SRC_SYSTEM::string, ''), coalesce(s.PROCESS_TYPE::string, ''), coalesce(s.SOURCE_DATA_CREATED_AT::string, '')) as SCD_ROW_KEY,
        
        s.SRC_SYSTEM,
        
        s.ENTITY_CD,
        
        s.DATA_SRC_SYSTEM,
        
        s.PROCESS_TYPE,
        
        
        s.IS_GROSS,
        
        s.SOURCE_DATA_CREATED_AT as VALID_FROM,
        cast(null as timestamp_ntz) as VALID_TO,
        true as IS_ACTIVE,
        
    '20260916'::VARCHAR AS BATCH_DT,
    '207ed2a4-922e-49c4-b0c2-0ffda55b77c3'::VARCHAR AS DBT_INVOCATION_ID,
    'SLV_POLICY_DIM_PROCESSTYPE_GROSS'::VARCHAR AS JOB_ID,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()::TIMESTAMP_NTZ(6) AS LOAD_TS


    from source_data s
    left join current_target t
        on s.SRC_SYSTEM = t.SRC_SYSTEM and s.ENTITY_CD = t.ENTITY_CD and s.DATA_SRC_SYSTEM = t.DATA_SRC_SYSTEM and s.PROCESS_TYPE = t.PROCESS_TYPE

    where
        t.SRC_SYSTEM is null and t.ENTITY_CD is null and t.DATA_SRC_SYSTEM is null and t.PROCESS_TYPE is null
        or (
            s.SRC_SYSTEM, s.ENTITY_CD, s.DATA_SRC_SYSTEM, s.PROCESS_TYPE
        ) in (
            select SRC_SYSTEM, ENTITY_CD, DATA_SRC_SYSTEM, PROCESS_TYPE
            from changed_keys
        )

),

final as (

    select * from rows_to_close
    union all
    select * from rows_to_insert
    qualify row_number() over (partition by SCD_ROW_KEY order by IS_ACTIVE asc) = 1
        -- kalau SCD_ROW_KEY bentrok (edge case: 2 perubahan di hari sama
        -- dengan VALID_FROM granularity harian), prioritaskan row INSERT
        -- (IS_ACTIVE=true) sebagai versi final -- row CLOSE yang kalah
        -- akan otomatis diperlakukan sebagai "belum sempat di-close",
        -- tapi versi barunya tetap benar. Ini pengaman terakhir, BUKAN
        -- pengganti fix akar masalah (lihat CATATAN #6 di bawah)
)

    select
        t.SCD_ROW_KEY,
        
        t.PRODUCT_CD,
        
        
        t.PRODUCT_GRP,
        
        t.VALID_FROM,
        current_timestamp()::timestamp_ntz   as VALID_TO,
        false as IS_ACTIVE,
        t.BATCH_ID,
        t.DBT_INVOCATION_ID,        
        t.JOB_ID,
        t.LOAD_TS

    from current_target t
    inner join changed_keys c
        on t.PRODUCT_CD = c.PRODUCT_CD

),

rows_to_insert as (

    select
        hash(coalesce(s.PRODUCT_CD::string, ''), coalesce(s.SOURCE_DATA_CREATED_AT::string, '')) as SCD_ROW_KEY,
        
        s.PRODUCT_CD,
        
        
        s.PRODUCT_GRP,
        
        s.SOURCE_DATA_CREATED_AT as VALID_FROM,
        cast(null as timestamp_ntz) as VALID_TO,
        true as IS_ACTIVE,
        
    '20260916'::VARCHAR AS BATCH_DT,
    '207ed2a4-922e-49c4-b0c2-0ffda55b77c3'::VARCHAR AS DBT_INVOCATION_ID,
    'SLV_PRODUCT_DIM_TM_PRODUCT_GRP'::VARCHAR AS JOB_ID,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()::TIMESTAMP_NTZ(6) AS LOAD_TS


    from source_data s
    left join current_target t
        on s.PRODUCT_CD = t.PRODUCT_CD

    where
        t.PRODUCT_CD is null
        or (
            s.PRODUCT_CD
        ) in (
            select PRODUCT_CD
            from changed_keys
        )

),

final as (

    select * from rows_to_close
    union all
    select * from rows_to_insert
    qualify row_number() over (partition by SCD_ROW_KEY order by IS_ACTIVE asc) = 1
        -- kalau SCD_ROW_KEY bentrok (edge case: 2 perubahan di hari sama
        -- dengan VALID_FROM granularity harian), prioritaskan row INSERT
        -- (IS_ACTIVE=true) sebagai versi final -- row CLOSE yang kalah
        -- akan otomatis diperlakukan sebagai "belum sempat di-close",
        -- tapi versi barunya tetap benar. Ini pengaman terakhir, BUKAN
        -- pengganti fix akar masalah (lihat CATATAN #6 di bawah)
)





select * from final

    WITH DIMPRODUCT AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT

                WHEN UPPER(DP.PRODUCT_SYSTEM_CD_ACTUARY) IN ('CCP', 'PP') THEN 'CCP'
                WHEN UPPER(DP.PRODUCT_SYSTEM_CD_ACTUARY) LIKE '%CLP%' AND UPPER(DP.PRODUCT_SYSTEM_CD_ACTUARY) NOT LIKE '%CLP COINS%' THEN 'CLP & OTHERS'
                WHEN UPPER(DP.PRODUCT_SYSTEM_CD_ACTUARY) LIKE '%CLP COINS%' OR UPPER(DP.PRODUCT_SYSTEM_CD_ACTUARY) IN ('KSM', 'KUR', 'KUM') THEN 'COIN MAGI'
                WHEN UPPER(DP.PRODUCT_SYSTEM_CD_ACTUARY) = 'MTR' THEN 'MTR'
                WHEN UPPER(DP.PRODUCT_SYSTEM_CD_ACTUARY) IN ('AMMS30','MKE','SJTR100LV','SJTR30LV','AMMSE1','AMMSE2','AMMSE3','AMMSE4','AMMSE5') THEN 'NEW BUNDLING'
                WHEN UPPER(DP.PRODUCT_SYSTEM_CD_ACTUARY) = 'CS' THEN 'CS'
                WHEN UPPER(DP.CHANNEL_DESC) = 'Agency' THEN 'AXA FI'
                WHEN UPPER(DP.CHANNEL_DESC) = 'GrGROUPoup' THEN 'GROUP'
                WHEN UPPER(DP.ENTITY) = 'AMFS' AND UPPER(DP.CHANNEL_DESC) = 'BANCASSURANCE' THEN 'AXA MFS IN-BRANCH FA'
                WHEN UPPER(DP.ENTITY) = 'AFI' AND UPPER(DP.CHANNEL_DESC) = 'CORPORATE SOLUTION' THEN 'AXA FI GROUP'
                WHEN UPPER(DP.ENTITY) = 'AMFS' AND UPPER(DP.CHANNEL_DESC) = 'CORPORATE SOLUTION' AND UPPER(DP.AMBITION_CD) LIKE '%DPLK%' THEN 'DPLK'
                WHEN UPPER(DP.ENTITY) = 'AMFS' AND UPPER(DP.CHANNEL_DESC) = 'CORPORATE SOLUTION' THEN 'AXA MFS CORPORATE SOLUTION'
                WHEN UPPER(DP.ENTITY) = 'ALI' AND UPPER(DP.CHANNEL_DESC) = 'TELEMARKETING' THEN 'AXA LI TM'
                WHEN UPPER(DP.ENTITY) = 'AMFS' AND UPPER(DP.CHANNEL_DESC) = 'TELEMARKETING' THEN 'AXA MFS TM'
            ELSE NULL END AS SUBCHANNEL_CD
        FROM SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PRODUCT DP
    )

    ,DMTM_POLICY AS (
    SELECT
        POLICY.POLICY_NO
        ,'TM' AS CHANNEL_CD
        ,PYMT_MTHD AS PYMT_MTHD_CD
        ,PYMT_MODE_CD AS PYMT_MODE_CD
        ,NULL AS BANK_SRC_CD
        ,NULL AS IS_HNW
        ,POLICY.PRODUCT_CD AS PRODUCT_CD
        ,CASE 
            WHEN ALTERNATE.PRODUCT_CD IS NULL THEN 'TM'
            END AS PRODUCT_CHANNEL
        ,CASE 
            WHEN UPPER(ALTERNATE.PRODUCT_GRP) IN ('AMMS30','MTR','AMMS100') OR POLICY.PRODUCT_CD LIKE 'SJTR50LV%' THEN 'New Bundling'
            WHEN UPPER(ALTERNATE.PRODUCT_GRP) IN ('MMS','IBC') AND ALTERNATE.PRODUCT_CD <> 'AKPE_BPJS'
                AND (UPPER(POLICY.BRANCH_CD) NOT IN ('AXA0AMFS',NULL,'AXA AMFS','404BVT','000000','BM.001','ASI') 
                OR UPPER(POLICY.PRODUCT_CD) IN ('AMMSLP','AMMSLP1','AMMSLP2','AMMSLP3','AMMSLP4','AMMSLP5')) THEN 'MMS'
            WHEN UPPER(POLICY.PRODUCT_CD) = 'CLPMTP' THEN 'CLP & Others'
            WHEN UPPER(MASTERPRODUCT.CHANNEL) = 'BANCASSURANCE' THEN 'AXA MFS IN-BRANCH FA'
            WHEN ALTERNATE.PRODUCT_CD IS NULL THEN 'AXA MFS TM'
        END AS PRODUCT_SUBCHANNEL
        ,BRANCH_CD
        ,AGENT_CD::VARCHAR AS FA_CD
        ,NULL AS PROD_AGENT_CD
        ,EFF_DT AS EFF_DT
        ,PYMT.CREATED_DT AS ISSUE_DT
        ,NULL AS SUBMIT_DT
        ,NULL AS EXP_DT
        ,NULL AS TERMINATE_DT
        ,POLICY.POLICY_STATUS_CD AS POLICY_STAT_CD
        ,CASE 
            WHEN POLICY_STAT_CD IN ('CA','SU','CO','X') THEN CANCEL_DT 
            WHEN POLICY_STAT_CD IN ('LA','EX') THEN LAPSE_DT
            WHEN POLICY_STAT_CD IN ('PU','IN') THEN POLICY.MODIFY_DT
        END AS POLICY_STAT_DT
        ,NULL AS MAINT_CD
        ,NULL AS MAINT_EFF_DT
        ,NULL AS REINSTATE_EFF_DT
        ,NULL AS PAID_TO_DT
        ,NULL AS LAST_PYMT_DT
        ,POLICY.CCY_CD AS POLICY_CCY_CD
        ,POLICY.OWN_ID AS OWN_ID_NO
        ,CASE 
            WHEN PRD.CATEGORY_CD ='CI' THEN 'CRITICAL ILLNESS'
            WHEN PRD.CATEGORY_CD ='CP' THEN 'CREDIT PROTECTION'
            WHEN PRD.CATEGORY_CD = 'H' THEN 'HEALTH'
            WHEN PRD.CATEGORY_CD ='L' THEN 'LIFE'
            WHEN PRD.CATEGORY_CD ='PA' THEN 'P/A'
        END AS POLICY_TYPE
        ,NULL AS IS_RECEIVE_SMS
        ,NULL AS FAMILY_DISC_PCT
        ,NULL AS DEATH_BENEFIT_OPT
        ,POLICY.BASIC_PREMI_AMT AS BASIC_PREMI_AMT
        ,NULL AS TOPUP_REG_MODAL_PREMI_AMT
        ,NULL AS INIT_LUMP_SUM_PREMI_AMT
        ,NULL AS LUMP_SUM_PREMI_AMT
        ,NULL AS MODAL_COMM_AMT
        ,NULL AS TOTAL_TOPUP_REG_MODAL_COMM_AMT
        ,NULL AS LIFE_SUM_INSURED_AMT
        ,POLICY.CREDIT_VAL AS TOTAL_SUM_INSURED_AMT
        ,NULL AS APE_RESTATE_NORATE_AMT
        ,NULL AS APE_PERSISTENCY_NORATE_AMT
        ,CASE 
            WHEN PYMT_MODE_CD = 'M' THEN TOTAL_PREMI_AMT * 12 
            WHEN PYMT_MODE_CD = 'S' THEN TOTAL_PREMI_AMT * 2 
            WHEN PYMT_MODE_CD = 'Q' THEN TOTAL_PREMI_AMT * 4 
            ELSE TOTAL_PREMI_AMT * 0.1 END AS APE_AMT
        ,NULL AS TERM_YEAR
        ,NULL AS TERM_MTH
        ,NULL AS RATE
        ,NULL AS NOTES
        ,NULL AS REF_NO        
        ,'DMTM' AS SRC_SYSTEM
        ,
    '20260916'::VARCHAR AS BATCH_DT,
    '207ed2a4-922e-49c4-b0c2-0ffda55b77c3'::VARCHAR AS DBT_INVOCATION_ID,
    'SLV_POLICY_FACT_MASTER_POL'::VARCHAR AS JOB_ID,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()::TIMESTAMP_NTZ(6) AS LOAD_TS

    FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_DMTM.POLICY POLICY
    LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_DMTM.PAYMENT PYMT
        ON POLICY.POLICY_NO = PYMT.POLICY_NO 
    LEFT JOIN SLV_DMTM.PRODUCT PRD 
        ON POLICY.PRODUCT_CD = PRD.PRODUCT_CD        
    LEFT JOIN SLV_MAN.ALTERNATE_PRODUCT_GROUP ALTERNATE
        ON ALTERNATE.PRODUCT_CD = POLICY.PRODUCT_CD
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PRODUCT_CD, CHANNEL, CCY_CD FROM SLV_MAN.MASTERPRODUCT WHERE SYSTEM='DMTM') MASTERPRODUCT
        ON POLICY.PRODUCT_CD = MASTERPRODUCT.PRODUCT_CD
        AND MASTERPRODUCT.CCY_CD = POLICY.CCY_CD   
        GROUP BY ALL
)

    SELECT
        MB.ENTITY
        ,CONCAT(MB.YR,TO_CHAR(MB.MTH, '00')) AS MTH_KEY
        ,DP.PRODUCT_CD
        ,CASE
                WHEN DP.PRODUCT_SYSTEM_CD_ACTUARY IN ('CCP', 'PP') THEN 'CCP'
            WHEN DP.PRODUCT_SYSTEM_CD_ACTUARY LIKE '%CLP%' AND DP.PRODUCT_SYSTEM_CD_ACTUARY NOT LIKE '%CLP Coins%' THEN 'CLP & Others'
            WHEN DP.PRODUCT_SYSTEM_CD_ACTUARY LIKE '%CLP Coins%' OR DP.PRODUCT_SYSTEM_CD_ACTUARY IN ('KSM', 'KUR', 'KUM') THEN 'Coin MAGI'
            WHEN DP.PRODUCT_SYSTEM_CD_ACTUARY = 'MTR' THEN 'MTR'
            WHEN DP.PRODUCT_SYSTEM_CD_ACTUARY IN ('AMMS30','MKE','SJTR100LV','SJTR30LV','AMMSE1','AMMSE2','AMMSE3','AMMSE4','AMMSE5') THEN 'New Bundling'
            WHEN DP.PRODUCT_SYSTEM_CD_ACTUARY = 'CS' THEN 'CS'
            WHEN DP.CHANNEL_DESC = 'Agency' THEN 'AXA FI'
            WHEN DP.CHANNEL_DESC = 'Group' THEN 'Group'
            WHEN DP.ENTITY = 'AMFS' AND DP.CHANNEL_DESC = 'Bancassurance' THEN 'AXA MFS In-branch FA'
            WHEN DP.ENTITY = 'AFI' AND DP.CHANNEL_DESC = 'Corporate Solution' THEN 'AXA FI Group'
            WHEN DP.ENTITY = 'AMFS' AND DP.CHANNEL_DESC = 'Corporate Solution' AND DP.AMBITION_CD LIKE '%DPLK%' THEN 'DPLK'
            WHEN DP.ENTITY = 'AMFS' AND DP.CHANNEL_DESC = 'Corporate Solution' THEN 'AXA MFS Corporate Solution'
            WHEN DP.ENTITY = 'ALI' AND DP.CHANNEL_DESC = 'Telemarketing' THEN 'AXA LI TM'
            WHEN DP.ENTITY = 'AMFS' AND DP.CHANNEL_DESC = 'Telemarketing' THEN 'AXA MFS TM'
        END AS SUBCHANNEL_CD
        ,GRP.PRODUCT_GRP AS TM_PRODUCT_GRP
        ,MB.GMD_CD
        ,MB.APE_BUDGET AS APE_BUDGET_AMT
        ,MB.NBV_BUDGET AS NBV_BUDGET_AMT
        ,'MANUAL' AS SRC_SYSTEM
    FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_MAN.MASTERBUDGET MB
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT PRODUCT_CD, GMD_CD, PRODUCT_SYSTEM_CD_ACTUARY, ENTITY, CHANNEL_DESC, AMBITION_CD 
                FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PRODUCT WHERE PRODUCT_CD IS NOT NULL) DP
        ON MB.GMD_CD = DP.GMD_CD
    LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_TM_PRODUCT_GRP GRP
        ON DP.PRODUCT_CD = GRP.PRODUCT_CD 
        AND GRP.IS_ACTIVE = 1

    ,B.CHANNEL_DESC AS CHANNEL_DESC
    ,A.POLICY_NO AS POLICY_NO
    ,C.PRODUCT_CD AS PRODUCT_CD
    ,PD.PRODUCT_NM_CMU AS DESC
    ,A.PYMT_DT AS PYMT_DT
    ,A.DUE_DT AS DUE_DT
    ,DD.DAY_DESC_ENG AS RANGE_DUE_DT
    ,DATEDIFF(DAY, DUE_DT, PYMT_DT) AS AGE_PAY_DAY
    ,DAPD.DAY_DESC_INA AS RANGE_AGE_PAY_DAY
    ,C.PYMT_MODE_CD AS PYMT_MODE_CD
    ,PYMT_MODE.PYMT_MODE_ENG AS PYMT_MODE_DESC
    ,A.CHANNEL_DEBIT AS CHANNEL_DEBIT
    ,PD.PRODUCT_GRP_CMU AS PRODUCT_GRP_CMU
    ,DATEDIFF(YEAR,C.ISSUE_DT, CURRENT_DATE()) AS AGE_POL_YR
    ,DATEDIFF(MONTH,C.ISSUE_DT, CURRENT_DATE()) AS AGE_POL_MTH
    ,DAPM.MTH_DESC_INA AS RANGE_AGE_POL_MTH
    ,DAPY.YR_DESC_INA AS RANGE_AGE_POL_YR
    ,C.POLICY_CCY_CD AS CCY_CD
    ,RPC.PYMT_MODE_INA AS RANGE_PREMI_CAP_500M_IDR
    ,RPC3M.RANGE_DESC_INA AS RANGE_PREMI_CAP_3M_IDR
    ,RPC30K.PYMT_MODE_INA AS RANGE_PREMI_CAP_30K_USD
    ,C.FA_CD AS FA_CD
    ,A.REGION_DESC AS REGION_GRP_DESC
    ,A.PREMI_LCY_AMT AS COLL_LCY_AMT
    ,A.PREMI_FCY_AMT AS COLL_FCY_AMT
    ,A.SRC_SYSTEM AS SRC_SYSTEM
    ,A.DEBIT_STAT AS DEBIT_STAT
    ,A.POL_CAT_CD AS POL_CAT_CD
    ,POLCAT.POLICY_CAT_ENG AS POL_CAT_DESC
    ,
    '20260916'::VARCHAR AS BATCH_DT,
    '207ed2a4-922e-49c4-b0c2-0ffda55b77c3'::VARCHAR AS DBT_INVOCATION_ID,
    'GLD_REPORT_COLLECTION_MTH_DTL'::VARCHAR AS JOB_ID,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()::TIMESTAMP_NTZ(6) AS LOAD_TS

FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_FINACT.FACT_FINACT_DEBIT A
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CHANNEL_CD, CHANNEL_DESC FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_CHANNEL) B
    ON A.CHANNEL_CD = B.CHANNEL_CD
LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.FACT_MASTER_POL C
    ON A.POLICY_NO = C.POLICY_NO
    -- AND C.BATCH_ID = MAX(BATCH_ID)
LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PRODUCT PD
    ON C.PRODUCT_CD = PD.PRODUCT_CD
LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.DIM_DUE_DAY DD
    ON DAY(A.DUE_DT) BETWEEN DD.DAY_START_VAL AND DD.DAY_END_VAL
LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.DIM_AGE_PYMT_DAY DAPD
    ON AGE_PAY_DAY BETWEEN DAPD.DAY_START_VAL AND DAPD.DAY_END_VAL
LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.DIM_PYMT_MODE PYMT_MODE 
    ON C.PYMT_MODE_CD = PYMT_MODE.PYMT_MODE_CD
LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.DIM_POL_AGE_MTH DAPM
    ON AGE_POL_MTH BETWEEN DAPM.MTH_START_VAL AND DAPM.MTH_END_VAL
LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.DIM_AGE_POL_YR DAPY 
    ON AGE_POL_YR BETWEEN DAPY.YR_START_VAL AND DAPY.YR_END_VAL
LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.DIM_RANGE_PREMI_CAP_500M_IDR RPC 
    ON A.PREMI_LCY_AMT BETWEEN RPC.DAY_START_VAL AND RPC.DAY_END_VAL  
LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.DIM_RANGE_PREMI_CAP_3M_IDR RPC3M 
    ON A.PREMI_LCY_AMT BETWEEN RPC3M.RANGE_START_VAL AND RPC3M.RANGE_START_VAL
LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.DIM_RANGE_PREMI_CAP_30K_USD RPC30K 
    ON A.PREMI_FCY_AMT BETWEEN RPC30K.DAY_START_VAL AND RPC30K.DAY_END_VAL
LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.DIM_POL_CAT POLCAT 
    ON A.POL_CAT_CD = POLCAT.POLICY_CAT_CD

        ,NULL AS INCOMING_CNT
        ,NULL AS ABANDONED_CNT

        ,SUM(CASE WHEN IS_FCR = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NON_FCR_CNT

WITH 
    factmasterpol_submission AS (
        SELECT 
            TO_CHAR(DATEADD(DAY, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMMDD') AS PERIOD_KEY
            ,TO_CHAR(DATEADD(DAY, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMM') AS FACT_PERIOD
            ,B.PRODUCT_GRP
            ,A.PRODUCT_CD
            ,CONCAT(DP.MTH_NM,' ',RIGHT(DP.CALENDAR_YR,2)) AS MTH_DESC
            
            ,SUM(CASE
                WHEN (CASE WHEN A.POLICY_STAT_CD IN ('CA','CO') THEN LEFT(A.CANCEL_DT,6)
                        WHEN A.POLICY_STAT_CD = 'IN' THEN LEFT(A.EFF_DT,6)
                        WHEN A.POLICY_STAT_CD = 'PE' THEN LEFT(A.PAID_TO_DT,6)
                        END) = FACT_PERIOD THEN A.APE_AMT
                ELSE 0 END) AS SUBMISSION_APE_AMT  

            ,COUNT(CASE
                WHEN (CASE WHEN A.POLICY_STAT_CD IN ('CA','CO') THEN LEFT(A.CANCEL_DT,6)
                        WHEN A.POLICY_STAT_CD = 'IN' THEN LEFT(A.EFF_DT,6)
                        WHEN A.POLICY_STAT_CD = 'PE' THEN LEFT(A.PAID_TO_DT,6)
                        END) = FACT_PERIOD THEN A.POLICY_NO
                END) AS SUBMISSION_APE_CNT                  
     
        FROM (
            SELECT POLICY_NO, POLICY_STAT_CD, POLICY_STAT_DT, PRODUCT_CD, APE_AMT, NULL AS CANCEL_DT, EFF_DT, PAID_TO_DT
            FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.FACT_MASTER_POL
            WHERE SRC_SYSTEM='DMTM'   
            AND TO_CHAR(POLICY_STAT_DT,'YYYYMM') = TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE(),'YYYYMM')
        ) A
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_TM_PRODUCT_GRP B
            ON A.PRODUCT_CD = B.PRODUCT_CD
            AND B.IS_ACTIVE = 1
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PERIOD DP
            ON DP.MTH_KEY=TO_CHAR(DATEADD(DAY, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMM')  
        WHERE POLICY_STAT_CD='CO'
        GROUP BY ALL
)

    ,factmasterpol_inforce AS (
        SELECT 
            TO_CHAR(DATEADD(DAY, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMMDD') AS PERIOD_KEY
            ,TO_CHAR(DATEADD(DAY, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMM') AS FACT_PERIOD
            ,B.PRODUCT_GRP
            ,A.PRODUCT_CD
            ,CONCAT(DP.MTH_NM,' ',RIGHT(DP.CALENDAR_YR,2)) AS MTH_DESC
            ,SUM(A.APE_AMT) AS INFORCE_APE_AMT
            ,COUNT(A.POLICY_NO) AS INFORCE_APE_CNT 
        FROM (
            SELECT POLICY_NO, POLICY_STAT_CD, POLICY_STAT_DT, PRODUCT_CD, APE_AMT
            FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.FACT_MASTER_POL
            WHERE SRC_SYSTEM='DMTM'   
            AND POLICY_STAT_DT >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', DATEADD(MONTH, -2, CURRENT_DATE()))
            AND POLICY_STAT_DT < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CURRENT_DATE())        
            QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY POLICY_NO ORDER BY POLICY_STAT_DT DESC) = 1
        ) A
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_TM_PRODUCT_GRP B
            ON A.PRODUCT_CD = B.PRODUCT_CD
            AND B.IS_ACTIVE = 1
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PERIOD DP
            ON DP.MTH_KEY=TO_CHAR(DATEADD(DAY, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMM')  
        WHERE POLICY_STAT_CD='IN'
        GROUP BY ALL
)

    ,factmasterpol_pending AS (
        SELECT 
            TO_CHAR(DATEADD(DAY, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMMDD') AS PERIOD_KEY
            ,TO_CHAR(DATEADD(DAY, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMM') AS FACT_PERIOD
            ,B.PRODUCT_GRP
            ,A.PRODUCT_CD
            ,CONCAT(DP.MTH_NM,' ',RIGHT(DP.CALENDAR_YR,2)) AS MTH_DESC
            ,SUM(A.APE_AMT) AS PENDING_APE_AMT
            ,COUNT(A.POLICY_NO) AS PENDING_APE_CNT 
        FROM (
            SELECT POLICY_NO, POLICY_STAT_CD, POLICY_STAT_DT, PRODUCT_CD, APE_AMT
            FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.FACT_MASTER_POL
            WHERE SRC_SYSTEM='DMTM'   
            AND POLICY_STAT_DT >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', DATEADD(MONTH, -2, CURRENT_DATE()))
            AND POLICY_STAT_DT < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CURRENT_DATE())        
            QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY POLICY_NO ORDER BY POLICY_STAT_DT DESC) = 1
        ) A
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_TM_PRODUCT_GRP B
            ON A.PRODUCT_CD = B.PRODUCT_CD
            AND B.IS_ACTIVE = 1
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PERIOD DP
            ON DP.MTH_KEY=TO_CHAR(DATEADD(DAY, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMM')  
        WHERE POLICY_STAT_CD='PE'
        GROUP BY ALL
)

    ,factmasterpol_cancelled AS (
        SELECT 
            TO_CHAR(DATEADD(DAY, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMMDD') AS PERIOD_KEY
            ,TO_CHAR(DATEADD(DAY, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMM') AS FACT_PERIOD
            ,B.PRODUCT_GRP

            WHERE SRC_SYSTEM='DMTM'

        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_TM_PRODUCT_GRP B
            ON A.PRODUCT_CD = B.PRODUCT_CD
            AND B.IS_ACTIVE = 1
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PERIOD DP
            ON DP.MTH_KEY=TO_CHAR(DATEADD(DAY, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMM')  
        WHERE POLICY_STAT_CD='CA'
        GROUP BY ALL

    ,factmasterpol_cooloff AS (
        SELECT 
            TO_CHAR(DATEADD(DAY, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMMDD') AS PERIOD_KEY
            ,TO_CHAR(DATEADD(DAY, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMM') AS FACT_PERIOD
            ,B.PRODUCT_GRP
            ,A.PRODUCT_CD
            ,CONCAT(DP.MTH_NM,' ',RIGHT(DP.CALENDAR_YR,2)) AS MTH_DESC
            ,SUM(A.APE_AMT) AS COOLOFF_APE_AMT
            ,COUNT(A.POLICY_NO) AS COOLOFF_APE_CNT 
        FROM (
            SELECT POLICY_NO, POLICY_STAT_CD, POLICY_STAT_DT, PRODUCT_CD, APE_AMT
            FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.FACT_MASTER_POL
            WHERE SRC_SYSTEM='DMTM'   
            AND TO_CHAR(POLICY_STAT_DT,'YYYYMM') = TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE(),'YYYYMM')
        ) A
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_TM_PRODUCT_GRP B
            ON A.PRODUCT_CD = B.PRODUCT_CD
            AND B.IS_ACTIVE = 1
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PERIOD DP
            ON DP.MTH_KEY=TO_CHAR(DATEADD(DAY, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMM')  
        WHERE POLICY_STAT_CD='CO'
        GROUP BY ALL
)

    ,factmasterpol_cooloffnet AS (
        SELECT 
            TO_CHAR(DATEADD(DAY, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMMDD') AS PERIOD_KEY
            ,TO_CHAR(DATEADD(DAY, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMM') AS FACT_PERIOD
            ,B.PRODUCT_GRP
            ,A.PRODUCT_CD
            ,CONCAT(DP.MTH_NM,' ',RIGHT(DP.CALENDAR_YR,2)) AS MTH_DESC

            ,SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN A.MODIFY_DT >= TO_DATE(FACT_PERIOD || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')
                     AND A.MODIFY_DT < DATEADD(MONTH,1,TO_DATE(FACT_PERIOD || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'))
                     AND A.EFF_DT < TO_DATE(FACT_PERIOD || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')
                    THEN A.APE_AMT
                ELSE 0 END
            ) AS COOLOFF_NET_APE_AMT
            
            ,COUNT(A.POLICY_NO) AS COOLOFF_APE_CNT 

            ,COUNT(
                CASE
                    WHEN A.MODIFY_DT >= TO_DATE(FACT_PERIOD || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')
                     AND A.MODIFY_DT < DATEADD(MONTH,1,TO_DATE(FACT_PERIOD || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'))
                     AND A.EFF_DT < TO_DATE(FACT_PERIOD || '01', 'YYYYMMDD')
                    THEN A.POLICY_NO
                END
            ) AS COOLOFF_NET_APE_CNT
            
        FROM (
            SELECT POLICY_NO, POLICY_STAT_CD, POLICY_STAT_DT, PRODUCT_CD, APE_AMT, NULL AS MODIFY_DT, EFF_DT
            FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.FACT_MASTER_POL
            WHERE SRC_SYSTEM='DMTM'   
            AND TO_CHAR(POLICY_STAT_DT,'YYYYMM') = TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE(),'YYYYMM')
        ) A
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_TM_PRODUCT_GRP B
            ON A.PRODUCT_CD = B.PRODUCT_CD
            AND B.IS_ACTIVE = 1
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PERIOD DP
            ON DP.MTH_KEY=TO_CHAR(DATEADD(DAY, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMM')  
        WHERE POLICY_STAT_CD='CO'
        GROUP BY ALL

WITH LIVECHAT AS(
    SELECT
        -- NULL AS CASE_MEDIA 
        NULL AS CASE_DESC
        ,NULL AS REQUEST_TYPE_CD
        ,NULL AS TOTAL_CASE_CNT
        ,NULL AS PHONE_CASE_CNT
        ,NULL AS WEB_CASE_CNT
        ,NULL AS CHAT_CASE_CNT
        ,NULL AS WA_CASE_CNT
        ,NULL AS LIVECHAT_CASE_CNT
        ,NULL AS EMAIL_CASE_CNT
        ,NULL AS EMAIL_SENT_CNT
        ,AVG(CHAT_DURATION) AS AVG_CHAT_DURATION
        ,AVG(WAIT_TIME) AS AVG_WAIT_DURATION
        ,AVG(AVG_RESPONSE_TIME_OPERATOR) AS AVG_RESPONSE_DURATION
    FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PARTY.FACT_PARTY_LIVECHAT_TRANSCRIPT
),

CASE AS(
    SELECT
        -- C.ORIGIN AS CASE_MEDIA
        C.CASE_TYPE AS CASE_DESC
        ,C.REQUEST_TYPE_CD AS REQUEST_TYPE_CD
        ,COUNT(DISTINCT C.REQUEST_ID) AS TOTAL_CASE_CNT
        
        ,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN UPPER(C.ORIGIN) = 'PHONE'
            AND CREATED_BY_NM IN(
                SELECT CREATED_BY_NM 
                FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PARTY.DIM_USER_CREATEDBYCCC
                WHERE UPPER(TYPE_USER) = 'INBOUND - CASETYPE'
            ) THEN C.REQUEST_ID
            END
        )AS PHONE_CASE_CNT
        
        ,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN UPPER(C.ORIGIN) = 'WEB'
            THEN C.REQUEST_ID
            END 
        )AS WEB_CASE_CNT
        
        ,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN UPPER(C.ORIGIN) = 'CHATBOT' 
            THEN C.REQUEST_ID
            END
        )AS CHAT_CASE_CNT
        
        ,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN UPPER(C.ORIGIN) = 'WHATSAPP'
            AND CREATED_BY_NM IN(
                SELECT CREATED_BY_NM 
                FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PARTY.DIM_USER_CREATEDBYCCC
            ) THEN C.REQUEST_ID
            END
        )AS WA_CASE_CNT
        
        ,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN UPPER(C.ORIGIN) IN ('WEB','CHATBOT','WHATSAPP') 
            THEN C.REQUEST_ID
            END
        )AS LIVECHAT_CASE_CNT
        
        ,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN UPPER(C.ORIGIN) = 'EMAIL'
            AND CREATED_BY_NM IN(
                SELECT CREATED_BY_NM 
                FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PARTY.DIM_USER_CREATEDBYCCC
                WHERE UPPER(TYPE_USER) = 'EMAIL'
            )THEN C.REQUEST_ID
            END
        )AS EMAIL_CASE_CNT
        
        ,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN UPPER(C.ORIGIN) = 'EMAIL' 
            AND UPPER(E.STATUS) = 'SEND'
            THEN C.REQUEST_ID
            END
        )AS EMAIL_SENT_CNT

        ,NULL AS AVG_CHAT_DURATION
        ,NULL AS AVG_WAIT_DURATION
        ,NULL AS AVG_RESPONSE_DURATION
    
    FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PARTY.FACT_PARTY_CASE C
    LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PARTY.FACT_PARTY_EMAIL_SMS_LOG E ON C.REQUEST_ID = E.REQUEST_NO
    
    
    WHERE UPPER(C.ORIGIN) IN ('PHONE','EMAIL','WEB','CHATBOT','WHATSAPP')
    AND UPPER(C.ENTITY) = 'AMFS'
    -- AND REQUEST_DT BETWEEN 
    GROUP BY 
        C.CASE_TYPE
        ,C.REQUEST_TYPE_CD
)

SELECT * FROM CASE
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM LIVECHAT

SELECT 
    A.FACT_PERIOD AS FACT_PERIOD
    ,A.CHANNEL_CD AS CHANNEL_CD
    ,B.CHANNEL_DESC AS CHANNEL_DESC
    ,A.POL_CAT_CD AS POL_CAT_CD
    ,POLCAT.POLICY_CAT_ENG AS POL_CAT_DESC
    ,C.PRODUCT_CD AS PRODUCT_CD
    ,PD.PRODUCT_NM_CMU AS PRODUCT_NM_CMU
    ,C.PYMT_MODE_CD AS PYMT_MODE_CD
    ,PYMT_MODE.PYMT_MODE_ENG AS PYMT_MODE_DESC
    ,C.POLICY_CCY_CD AS CCY_CD
    ,A.REGION_DESC AS REGION_GRP_DESC
    ,RPC3M.RANGE_DESC_INA AS RANGE_PREMI_CAP_3M_IDR
    ,RPC.PYMT_MODE_INA AS RANGE_PREMI_CAP_500M_IDR   
    ,RPC30K.PYMT_MODE_INA AS RANGE_PREMI_CAP_30K_USD   
    ,DATEDIFF(YEAR,C.ISSUE_DT, CURRENT_DATE()) AS AGE_POL_YR    
    ,DAPY.YR_DESC_INA AS RANGE_AGE_POL_YR
    ,DATEDIFF(DAY, DUE_DT, PYMT_DT) AS AGE_PAY_DAY    
    ,DAPD.DAY_DESC_INA AS RANGE_AGE_PAY_DAY   
    ,SUM(A.PREMI_LCY_AMT) AS COLL_LCY_AMT
    ,SUM(A.PREMI_FCY_AMT) AS COLL_FCY_AMT
    ,COUNT(DISTINCT A.POLICY_NO) AS COLL_TOT_CNT
    ,SUM(CASE WHEN A.DEBIT_STAT = 'SUCCESS' THEN A.PREMI_LCY_AMT END) AS COLL_SUCCESS_LCY_AMT
    ,SUM(CASE WHEN A.DEBIT_STAT = 'SUCCESS' THEN A.PREMI_FCY_AMT END) AS COLL_SUCCESS_FCY_AMT
    ,SUM(CASE WHEN A.DEBIT_STAT = 'FAILED' THEN A.PREMI_LCY_AMT END) AS COLL_FAIL_LCY_AMT
    ,SUM(CASE WHEN A.DEBIT_STAT = 'FAILED' THEN A.PREMI_FCY_AMT END) AS COLL_FAIL_FCY_AMT
    ,COUNT(DISTINCT(CASE WHEN A.DEBIT_STAT = 'SUCCESS' THEN A.POLICY_NO END)) AS COLL_SUCCESS_CNT
    ,COUNT(DISTINCT(CASE WHEN A.DEBIT_STAT = 'FAILED' THEN A.POLICY_NO END)) AS COLL_FAIL_CNT
    ,
    '20260916'::VARCHAR AS BATCH_DT,
    '207ed2a4-922e-49c4-b0c2-0ffda55b77c3'::VARCHAR AS DBT_INVOCATION_ID,
    'GLD_REPORT_COLLECTION_MTH_SMY'::VARCHAR AS JOB_ID,

        ON A.CHANNEL_CD = B.CHANNEL_CD
    LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.FACT_MASTER_POL C

        -- AND C.BATCH_ID = MAX(BATCH_ID)
    LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PRODUCT PD

    LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.DIM_DUE_DAY DD

    LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.DIM_AGE_PYMT_DAY DAPD

    LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.DIM_PYMT_MODE PYMT_MODE

    -- LEFT JOIN SLV_POLICY.DIM_POL_AGE_MTH DAPM

    LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.DIM_AGE_POL_YR DAPY

    LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.DIM_RANGE_PREMI_CAP_500M_IDR RPC

    LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.DIM_POL_CAT POLCAT

WITH 
    DIM_PERIOD_MAPPING AS (
        SELECT
            PERIOD_KEY,
            DATE,
            MTH_KEY,
            IS_WORK_DAY,
            MIN(CASE WHEN IS_WORK_DAY = 1 THEN DATE END) OVER (PARTITION BY MTH_KEY) AS FIRST_WORK_DAY,
            MAX(CASE WHEN IS_WORK_DAY = 1 THEN DATE END) OVER (PARTITION BY MTH_KEY ORDER BY DATE 
                ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS PREV_WORK_DAY
        FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PERIOD
)

    ,DP1 AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT PRODUCT_CD, CCY_CD, APE_MIX, PRODUCT_CHANNEL, CLP_CHANNEL, SPLIT_PART(AMBITION_CD, '_', 1) AMBITION_CD
        FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PRODUCT
        WHERE CCY_CD <> 'ALL'
)
    ,DP2 AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT PRODUCT_CD, APE_MIX, PRODUCT_CHANNEL, CLP_CHANNEL, SPLIT_PART(AMBITION_CD, '_', 1) AMBITION_CD
        FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PRODUCT
        WHERE CCY_CD = 'ALL'
)
    ,PREFINAL AS (       
        SELECT
            DCHAN.SUBCHANNEL_CD AS SUBCHANNEL_GRP
            ,DCHAN.CHANNEL_GRP AS CHANNEL_GRP
            ,TO_CHAR(DATEADD(DAY,-1,CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMM') FACT_PERIOD
            ,FMP.POLICY_NO
            ,FMP.PRODUCT_CD
            ,COALESCE(DP1.PRODUCT_CHANNEL,DP2.PRODUCT_CHANNEL) AS PRODUCT_CHANNEL
            ,CASE 
                WHEN FMP.SRC_SYSTEM='DMTM' AND COALESCE(DP1.CLP_CHANNEL,DP2.CLP_CHANNEL) IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(DP1.CLP_CHANNEL,DP2.CLP_CHANNEL)
                ELSE FMP.CHANNEL_CD END AS CLP_CHANNEL
            ,FMP.SRC_SYSTEM
            ,CASE WHEN BIZCASE.POLICY_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END IS_BIZCASE
            ,CASE WHEN FACT_PERIOD = TO_CHAR(FMP.SUBMIT_DT,'YYYYMM') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END IS_SUBMIT
            ,CASE 
                WHEN FACT_PERIOD = TO_CHAR(FMP.ISSUE_DT,'YYYYMM') AND FMP.POLICY_STAT_CD IN ('01','08') AND FMP.SRC_SYSTEM='CLP' THEN 1
                WHEN FACT_PERIOD = TO_CHAR(FMP.ISSUE_DT,'YYYYMM') AND (DPS.POLICY_STAT_ENG ='INFORCE' OR DPS.POLICY_STAT_GRP_1 ='INFORCE') THEN 1 
                ELSE 0 END IS_ISSUED
            ,CASE 
                WHEN DPS.POLICY_STAT_ENG ='CANCELLED' OR DPS.POLICY_STAT_GRP_1 ='CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 
                END IS_CANCELLED
            ,CASE 
                WHEN FMP.POLICY_STAT_CD = '00' AND FMP.SRC_SYSTEM = 'CLP' THEN 1
                WHEN DPS.POLICY_STAT_ENG ='PENDING' OR DPS.POLICY_STAT_GRP_1 ='PENDING' THEN 1 
                ELSE 0 END IS_PENDING
            ,COALESCE(CO.IS_COOLOFF, CASE WHEN DPS.POLICY_STAT_ENG = 'COOLING OFF' OR DPS.POLICY_STAT_GRP_1='COOLING OFF' THEN 1 END) IS_COOLOFF
            ,SUM(TOTAL_SUM_INSURED_AMT) AS SUM_INSURED_AMT
            ,SUM(CASE 
                WHEN UPPER(FMP.PRODUCT_SUBCHANNEL) ='NEW BUNDLING' THEN 0.1 * FMP.APE_AMT
                WHEN UPPER(FMP.PRODUCT_SUBCHANNEL) = 'MMS' AND COALESCE(DP1.AMBITION_CD,DP2.AMBITION_CD) NOT LIKE '%SJT%' THEN 0.1 * FMP.APE_AMT
                WHEN UPPER(FMP.PRODUCT_SUBCHANNEL) = 'AXA MFS IN-BRANCH FA' AND FMP.SRC_SYSTEM = 'DMTM' THEN 0.5 * FMP.APE_AMT
                WHEN UPPER(FMP.PRODUCT_SUBCHANNEL) = 'CLP & OTHERS' THEN 0.1 * FMP.APE_AMT
                ELSE FMP.APE_AMT END) AS APE_AMT
            ,COALESCE(DP1.APE_MIX,DP2.APE_MIX) AS APE_MIX
            ,CASE 
                WHEN IS_ISSUED = 1 THEN 'ISSUED_BASIC'
                WHEN IS_COOLOFF = 1 THEN 'COOLOFF_BASIC'
                END AS PROCESS_TYPE_GLD
            ,GROSS.IS_GROSS AS IS_GROSS
            ,CASE 
                WHEN GROSS.PROCESS_TYPE = 'ISSUED_BASIC' THEN 1 
                WHEN GROSS.PROCESS_TYPE = 'COOLOFF_BASIC' THEN -1 
                END AS CASE_CNT
            ,SUM(APE_AMT * IS_GROSS) AS APE_GROSS_AMT
            ,SUM(CASE_CNT * IS_GROSS) AS CASE_CNT_GROSS

            ,CASE 
                WHEN IS_ISSUED = 1 THEN FMP.ISSUE_DT
                WHEN IS_COOLOFF = 1 THEN FMP.POLICY_STAT_DT 
            END AS PERIOD_KEY
        
        FROM 
            (
                SELECT
                    POLICY_NO, PRODUCT_CD, CHANNEL_CD, SRC_SYSTEM, SUBMIT_DT, ISSUE_DT, POLICY_STAT_CD, POLICY_STAT_DT,
                    TOTAL_SUM_INSURED_AMT, APE_AMT, PRODUCT_SUBCHANNEL, POLICY_CCY_CD
                FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.FACT_MASTER_POL
                
                UNION ALL
                
                SELECT 
                    POLICY_NO, PRODUCT_CD, NULL AS CHANNEL_CD, SRC_SYSTEM, SUBMIT_DT, NULL AS ISSUE_DT, 
                    NULL AS POLICY_STAT_CD, NULL AS POLICY_STAT_DT, NULL AS TOTAL_SUM_INSURED_AMT, APE_AMT, PRODUCT_SUBCHANNEL, POLICY_CCY_CD
                FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_APPLICATION.FACT_MASTER_APPL
                WHERE POLICY_NO NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT POLICY_NO FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.FACT_MASTER_POL)
                AND LEFT(SUBMIT_DT,6) = TO_CHAR(DATEADD(DAY,-1,CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMM')
            ) FMP
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_CHANNEL DCHAN 
            ON DCHAN.SUBCHANNEL_CD = FMP.PRODUCT_SUBCHANNEL
        LEFT JOIN DP1  -----------------------------------> KURANG JOIN APE_MIX
            ON FMP.PRODUCT_CD = DP1.PRODUCT_CD 
            AND FMP.POLICY_CCY_CD = DP1.CCY_CD    
        LEFT JOIN DP2 -----------------------------------> KURANG JOIN APE_MIX
            ON FMP.PRODUCT_CD = DP2.PRODUCT_CD      
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.FACT_BIZCASE BIZCASE 
            ON FACT_PERIOD = BIZCASE.FACT_PERIOD 
            AND FMP.POLICY_NO = BIZCASE.POLICY_NO
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.DIM_POL_STAT DPS 
            ON FMP.POLICY_STAT_CD = DPS.POLICY_STAT_CD 
            AND DPS.IS_ACTIVE = 1
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.FACT_PATCH_CO CO 
            ON FACT_PERIOD = CO.FACT_PERIOD_PATCH 
            AND FMP.POLICY_NO =CO.POLICY_NO
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.DIM_PROCESSTYPE_GROSS GROSS
            ON PROCESS_TYPE_GLD = GROSS.PROCESS_TYPE 
            AND GROSS.IS_ACTIVE =1 
            AND GROSS.DATA_SRC_SYSTEM = FMP.SRC_SYSTEM
         
    GROUP BY ALL
)

        SELECT PF.*,
            CASE
                WHEN PM.IS_WORK_DAY = 1 THEN PF.PERIOD_KEY
                WHEN PM.DATE < PM.FIRST_WORK_DAY THEN TO_CHAR(PM.FIRST_WORK_DAY, 'YYYYMMDD')
                ELSE TO_CHAR(PM.PREV_WORK_DAY, 'YYYYMMDD')
            END AS WORK_DAY_PERIOD_KEY,
            
    '20260916'::VARCHAR AS BATCH_DT,
    '207ed2a4-922e-49c4-b0c2-0ffda55b77c3'::VARCHAR AS DBT_INVOCATION_ID,
    'GLD_REPORT_POLICY_DAILY_SMY'::VARCHAR AS JOB_ID,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()::TIMESTAMP_NTZ(6) AS LOAD_TS

    FROM PREFINAL PF
    LEFT JOIN DIM_PERIOD_MAPPING PM
        ON PF.PERIOD_KEY = PM.PERIOD_KEY

    with DP as (
        SELECT
            CALENDAR_YR
            ,PERIOD_KEY
            ,MTH_KEY
            ,PREV_MTH_KEY
            ,(MTH_KEY - 100) AS LY_MTH_KEY
            ,DATE
        FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PERIOD
        WHERE DATE <= DATEADD(DAY, -1, CURRENT_DATE())
        ORDER BY DATE DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ),
    
    metrics_base as (
        SELECT
            DCHAN.SUBCHANNEL_GRP
            ,DCHAN.CHANNEL_GRP
            ,DP.CALENDAR_YR
            ,DP.MTH_KEY as FACT_PERIOD
            ,DP.PERIOD_KEY
            ,FAB.APE_BUDGET_AMT as MONTHLY_APE_PLAN_AMT
    
            ,COALESCE(ACT.ISSUED_APE_AMT, SUM(CASE WHEN PDS.IS_ISSUED = 1  THEN PDS.APE_AMT END) + FID.ISSUED_APE_AMT) as MONTHLY_APE_ACT_AMT
            ,COALESCE(ACT.ISSUED_CASE_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN PDS.IS_ISSUED = 1  THEN PDS.CASE_CNT END) + FID.ISSUED_CASE_CNT) as MONTHLY_APE_ACT_CNT
            ,COALESCE(ACT.ISSUED_APE_AMT, SUM(CASE WHEN PDS.IS_ISSUED = 1  THEN PDS.APE_AMT END) + FID.ISSUED_APE_AMT)
 as LY_MONTHLY_APE_ACT_AMT
            ,COALESCE(ACT.ISSUED_CASE_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN PDS.IS_ISSUED = 1  THEN PDS.CASE_CNT END) + FID.ISSUED_CASE_CNT) as LY_MONTHLY_APE_ACT_CNT
            ,COALESCE(ACT.ISSUED_APE_AMT,
                SUM(CASE WHEN PDS.IS_ISSUED = 1 AND DP.MTH_KEY <= TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE()-1,'YYYYMM') THEN PDS.APE_AMT END) + FID.ISSUED_APE_AMT
                ) as YTD_APE_ACT_AMT
            ,COALESCE(ACT.ISSUED_CASE_CNT,
                SUM(CASE WHEN PDS.IS_ISSUED = 1 AND DP.MTH_KEY <= TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE()-1,'YYYYMM') THEN PDS.CASE_CNT END) + FID.ISSUED_CASE_CNT
                ) as YTD_APE_ACT_CNT
            ,SUM(CASE WHEN FAB.MTH_KEY <= TO_CHAR(DATEADD(DAY,-1,CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMM') THEN FAB.APE_BUDGET_AMT END) as YTD_APE_PLAN_AMT
    
            ,COALESCE(ACT.ISSUED_APE_AMT, 
                SUM(CASE WHEN PDS.IS_ISSUED = 1 AND DP.LY_MTH_KEY <= TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE()-1,'YYYYMM') - 100  THEN PDS.APE_AMT END) + FID.ISSUED_APE_AMT
                ) as LY_YTD_APE_ACT_AMT
            ,COALESCE(ACT.ISSUED_CASE_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN PDS.IS_ISSUED = 1  
                AND DP.LY_MTH_KEY <= TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE()-1,'YYYYMM') - 100 THEN PDS.CASE_CNT END) + FID.ISSUED_CASE_CNT
                ) as LY_YTD_APE_ACT_CNT
    
            ,COALESCE(ACT.ISSUED_APE_AMT, SUM(CASE WHEN PDS.IS_ISSUED = 1
                AND LEFT(DP.MTH_KEY,4) = TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE()-1,'YYYY') THEN PDS.APE_AMT END) + FID.ISSUED_APE_AMT
                ) as FULL_YR_APE_ACT_AMT
            ,COALESCE(ACT.ISSUED_CASE_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN PDS.IS_ISSUED = 1 
                AND LEFT(DP.MTH_KEY,4) = TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE()-1,'YYYY')  THEN PDS.CASE_CNT END) + FID.ISSUED_CASE_CNT
                ) as FULL_YR_APE_ACT_CNT
            ,SUM(CASE WHEN FAB.MTH_KEY <= TO_CHAR(DATEADD(DAY,-1,CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYY') THEN FAB.APE_BUDGET_AMT END) as FULL_YR_APE_PLAN_AMT
    
            ,COALESCE(ACT.ISSUED_APE_AMT, SUM(CASE WHEN PDS.IS_ISSUED = 1 
                AND LEFT(DP.LY_MTH_KEY,4) = TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE()-1,'YYYY') THEN PDS.APE_AMT END) + FID.ISSUED_APE_AMT
                ) as LY_FULL_YR_APE_ACT_AMT
            ,COALESCE(ACT.ISSUED_CASE_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN PDS.IS_ISSUED = 1 
                AND LEFT(DP.LY_MTH_KEY,4) = TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE()-1,'YYYY') THEN PDS.CASE_CNT END) + FID.ISSUED_CASE_CNT
                ) as LY_FULL_YR_APE_ACT_CNT
    
        FROM DP
        JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_CHANNEL DCHAN
            ON DCHAN.CHANNEL_GRP IN ('Alternate','Corporate Solution') 
            AND DCHAN.IS_ACTIVE = 1
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.FACT_APE_BUDGET FAB ON DCHAN.SUBCHANNEL_GRP = FAB.SUBCHANNEL_GRP AND FAB.MTH_KEY = DP.MTH_KEY
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.FACT_INDO_DAILY FID ON LEFT(FID.PERIOD_KEY,6) = DP.MTH_KEY AND FID.SUBCHANNEL_GRP = DCHAN.SUBCHANNEL_GRP
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.FACT_ACTUARY ACT ON ACT.MTH_KEY = DP.MTH_KEY AND ACT.SUBCHANNEL_GRP = DCHAN.SUBCHANNEL_GRP
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.GLD_REPORT.POLICY_DAILY_SMY PDS ON PDS.FACT_PERIOD = DP.MTH_KEY AND PDS.SUBCHANNEL_GRP = DCHAN.SUBCHANNEL_GRP AND PDS.IS_BIZCASE <> 1
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.FACT_INDO_DAILY FID_LY ON LEFT(FID_LY.PERIOD_KEY,6) = DP.LY_MTH_KEY AND FID_LY.SUBCHANNEL_GRP = DCHAN.SUBCHANNEL_GRP
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.FACT_ACTUARY ACT_LY ON ACT_LY.MTH_KEY = DP.LY_MTH_KEY AND ACT_LY.SUBCHANNEL_GRP = DCHAN.SUBCHANNEL_GRP
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.GLD_REPORT.POLICY_DAILY_SMY PDS_LY ON PDS_LY.FACT_PERIOD = DP.LY_MTH_KEY AND PDS_LY.SUBCHANNEL_GRP = DCHAN.SUBCHANNEL_GRP AND PDS_LY.IS_BIZCASE <> 1
    
        GROUP BY ACT_LY.ISSUED_CASE_CNT, FID_LY.ISSUED_CASE_CNT, ACT_LY.ISSUED_APE_AMT, FID_LY.ISSUED_APE_AMT, ACT.ISSUED_CASE_CNT, FID.ISSUED_CASE_CNT, ACT.ISSUED_APE_AMT, FID.ISSUED_APE_AMT, DCHAN.SUBCHANNEL_GRP, DCHAN.CHANNEL_GRP, DP.CALENDAR_YR, DP.MTH_KEY, DP.PERIOD_KEY, FAB.APE_BUDGET_AMT
    )
    
    SELECT
        *
        ,MONTHLY_APE_ACT_AMT / MONTHLY_APE_PLAN_AMT as MONTHLY_APE_AMT_ACT_VS_PLAN_PCT
        ,MONTHLY_APE_ACT_AMT / LY_MONTHLY_APE_ACT_AMT as CURR_VS_LY_MONTHLY_APE_AMT_ACT_PCT
        ,MONTHLY_APE_ACT_CNT / LY_MONTHLY_APE_ACT_CNT as CURR_VS_LY_MONTHLY_APE_CNT_ACT_PCT
        ,YTD_APE_ACT_AMT / YTD_APE_PLAN_AMT as YTD_APE_AMT_ACT_VS_PLAN_PCT
        ,YTD_APE_ACT_AMT / LY_YTD_APE_ACT_AMT as CURR_VS_LY_YTD_APE_AMT_ACT_PCT
        ,YTD_APE_ACT_CNT / LY_YTD_APE_ACT_CNT as CURR_VS_LY_YTD_APE_CNT_ACT_PCT
    FROM metrics_base

WITH DIM_PERIOD_MAPPING AS (
        SELECT
            PERIOD_KEY,
            DATE,
            MTH_KEY,
            IS_WORK_DAY,
            MIN(CASE WHEN IS_WORK_DAY = 1 THEN DATE END) OVER (PARTITION BY MTH_KEY) AS FIRST_WORK_DAY,
            MAX(CASE WHEN IS_WORK_DAY = 1 THEN DATE END) OVER (PARTITION BY MTH_KEY ORDER BY DATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS PREV_WORK_DAY,
            COUNT(CASE WHEN IS_WORK_DAY = 1 THEN 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY MTH_KEY) AS MAX_WD
        FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PERIOD
    )
    
    SELECT 
        netmth.PERIOD_KEY
        ,netmth.FACT_PERIOD
        ,netmth.PRODUCT_GRP
        ,SUM(INFORCE_APE_AMT) as CURR_DAY_INFORCE_APE_AMT
        ,SUM(INFORCE_APE_CNT) as CURR_DAY_INFORCE_APE_CNT
        ,SUM(INFORCE_APE_AMT) / SUM(INFORCE_APE_CNT) as PREMI_PER_YEAR_AVG
        ,SUM(INFORCE_APE_AMT) as PREV_DAY_INFORCE_APE_AMT
        ,SUM(INFORCE_APE_CNT) as PREV_DAY_INFORCE_APE_CNT
        ,CURR_DAY_INFORCE_APE_AMT - PREV_DAY_INFORCE_APE_AMT as INCREASE_APE_AMT
        ,CURR_DAY_INFORCE_APE_CNT - PREV_DAY_INFORCE_APE_CNT as INCREASE_APE_CNT
        ,SUM(COOLOFF_NET_APE_AMT) as CURR_DAY_COOLOFF_APE_AMT
        ,CURR_DAY_INFORCE_APE_AMT - CURR_DAY_COOLOFF_APE_AMT as CURR_DAY_NET_INFORCE_APE_AMT
        ,APE_BUDGET_AMT as CURR_DAY_PLAN_APE_AMT
        ,CURR_DAY_NET_INFORCE_APE_AMT/CURR_DAY_PLAN_APE_AMT as CURR_DAY_ACHV_PCT
        ,CASE
            WHEN dpm.IS_WORK_DAY = 1 THEN netmth.PERIOD_KEY
            WHEN dpm.DATE < dpm.FIRST_WORK_DAY THEN TO_CHAR(dpm.FIRST_WORK_DAY, 'YYYYMMDD')
        ELSE TO_CHAR(dpm.PREV_WORK_DAY, 'YYYYMMDD') END AS CURR_WORKING_DT
    
        ,dpm.MAX_WD
        ,CURR_DAY_NET_INFORCE_APE_AMT / CURR_WORKING_DT * dpm.MAX_WD / 1000000 as CURR_DAY_RUN_RATE

        ,
    '20260916'::VARCHAR AS BATCH_DT,
    '207ed2a4-922e-49c4-b0c2-0ffda55b77c3'::VARCHAR AS DBT_INVOCATION_ID,
    'GLD_REPORT_NET_APE_TM_YTD_SMY'::VARCHAR AS JOB_ID,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()::TIMESTAMP_NTZ(6) AS LOAD_TS

        
    FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.GLD_REPORT.NET_APE_TM_MTH_SMY netmth
    LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.FACT_GMD_MASTERBUDGET mb
        ON netmth.FACT_PERIOD = mb.MTH_KEY
        AND netmth.PRODUCT_GRP = mb.TM_PRODUCT_GRP
    LEFT JOIN DIM_PERIOD_MAPPING dpm
        ON netmth.PERIOD_KEY = dpm.PERIOD_KEY  
    WHERE FACT_PERIOD BETWEEN TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', TO_DATE('2026-09-09')),'YYYYMM') 
        AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('2026-09-09'),'YYYYMM')
    GROUP BY ALL

SELECT
    G.PRODUCT_CHANNEL as PRODUCT_CHANNEL,
    UPPER(C.CHANNEL_DESC) as CHANNEL_DESC,
    CASE
        WHEN G.IS_SUBMIT = 1 THEN 'SUBMITTED'
        WHEN G.IS_ISSUED = 1
        AND BILL.STATUS_CD = 'P' THEN 'ISSUED'
        WHEN A.IS_PENDING = 1
        AND BILL.STATUS_CD = 'N' THEN 'PENDING'
    END as FUNNEL_STAGE,
    A.SUBMIT_DT as SUBMIT_DT,
    A.APPLICATION_STATUS_CD as PARTICIPANT_NO,
    P.ISSUE_DT as ISSUE_DT,
    A.APPLICATION_STATUS_CD as APPLICATION_STATUS,
    P.POLICY_STAT_CD as POLICY_STATUS,
    O.OWN_NM as PARTICIPANT_NM,
    O.OWN_DOB as BIRTH_DT,

            END

WITH 
    CY_PERIOD AS (
        SELECT
            MTH_KEY AS CURRENT_PERIOD,
            COALESCE(MAX(
                CASE 
                    WHEN DATE=CURRENT_DATE()-1 THEN WORK_DAY_OF_MTH
                END),
                MAX(WORK_DAY_OF_MTH)
            ) AS WD_CY,
            COALESCE(MAX(
                CASE 
                    WHEN DATE=CURRENT_DATE()-1 THEN PREV_DAY_WORK_DAY_OF_MTH
                END),
                MAX(PREV_DAY_WORK_DAY_OF_MTH)
            ) AS PREVDAY_WD_CY,            
            MAX(WORK_DAY_OF_MTH) AS MAX_WD_CY,
        FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PERIOD
        WHERE MTH_KEY=TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE()-1,'YYYYMM')
        GROUP BY MTH_KEY
    )

    ,LY_PERIOD AS (
        SELECT
            TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE(),'YYYYMM') AS CURRENT_PERIOD,
            MAX(PREV_DAY_WORK_DAY_OF_MTH) AS PREVDAY_WD_LY,
            MAX(WORK_DAY_OF_MTH) AS MAX_WD_LY,
            COALESCE(MAX(
                CASE 
                    WHEN DATE=CURRENT_DATE() THEN WORK_DAY_OF_MTH
                END),
                MAX(WORK_DAY_OF_MTH)
            ) AS WD_LY
        FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PERIOD
        WHERE MTH_KEY=TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE(),'YYYYMM')-100
        GROUP BY MTH_KEY
    )

    ,ADJUST_WD AS ( 
        SELECT
            A.CURRENT_PERIOD,
            (CAST(A.WD_CY AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / NULLIF(A.MAX_WD_CY,0)) * B.MAX_WD_LY AS ADJUST_WD_LY,
            (CAST(A.PREVDAY_WD_CY AS DECIMAL(18,6)) / NULLIF(A.MAX_WD_CY,0)) * B.MAX_WD_LY AS ADJUST_WD_LY_MIN1,
            CEIL(ADJUST_WD_LY) AS ADJUST_WD_LY_UP,
            FLOOR(ADJUST_WD_LY) AS ADJUST_WD_LY_DOWN,
            CEIL(ADJUST_WD_LY_MIN1) AS ADJUST_WD_LY_UP_MIN1,
            FLOOR(ADJUST_WD_LY_MIN1) AS ADJUST_WD_LY_DOWN_MIN1
        FROM CY_PERIOD A
        LEFT JOIN LY_PERIOD B
            ON A.CURRENT_PERIOD=B.CURRENT_PERIOD
)
    ,YTD_LY_PERIOD AS (
        SELECT
            B.PERIOD_KEY AS PERIOD_KEY_CURRENT, A.WORK_DAY_OF_MTH, A.PERIOD_KEY AS PERIOD_KEY_LY, A.DATE AS DATE_YTD_LY, A.MTH_KEY AS MTH_KEY_YTD_LY
        FROM (SELECT * FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PERIOD WHERE MTH_KEY=TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE(),'YYYYMM')-100) A
        JOIN (SELECT PERIOD_KEY, WORK_DAY_OF_MTH FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PERIOD WHERE DATE=CURRENT_DATE()) B
            ON A.WORK_DAY_OF_MTH=B.WORK_DAY_OF_MTH
)

    ,POLICY_DAILY_MTD AS (
        SELECT 
            TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE(),'YYYYMM') AS CURRENT_PERIOD,
            CHANNEL_GRP,
            SUBCHANNEL_GRP,
            PDS.FACT_PERIOD,
            PDS.PERIOD_KEY::VARCHAR AS PERIOD_KEY,
            PDS.PERIOD_KEY::VARCHAR AS WORKING_DT,
            DP.WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,
            PDS.SRC_SYSTEM,
            SUM(APE_GROSS_AMT) AS MTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT,
            SUM(APE_AMT) AS MTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT,
            SUM(CASE_CNT_GROSS) AS CASE_CNT_GROSS,
            SUM(CASE_CNT) AS CASE_CNT
        FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.GLD_REPORT.POLICY_DAILY_SMY PDS
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PERIOD DP
            ON PDS.PERIOD_KEY=DP.PERIOD_KEY
        WHERE FACT_PERIOD=TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE(),'YYYYMM')
        GROUP BY ALL
)

    ,FACT_APE_BUDGET AS (
        SELECT 
            TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE(),'YYYYMM') AS CURRENT_PERIOD,
            NULL AS CHANNEL_GRP,
            SUBCHANNEL_GRP,
            PDS.MTH_KEY AS FACT_PERIOD,
            PDS.PERIOD_KEY::VARCHAR AS PERIOD_KEY,
            PDS.PERIOD_KEY::VARCHAR AS WORKING_DT,
            DP.WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,
            PDS.SRC_SYSTEM,
            SUM(PDS.BUDGET_DAILY_AMT * DP.WORK_DAY_OF_MTH) AS MTD_APE_PLAN_AMT,
            SUM(PDS.APE_BUDGET_AMT) AS MONTHLY_APE_PLAN_AMT
        FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.FACT_APE_BUDGET PDS
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PERIOD DP
            ON PDS.PERIOD_KEY=DP.PERIOD_KEY
        WHERE PDS.MTH_KEY=TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE(),'YYYYMM')
        GROUP BY ALL
)

    ,POLICY_DAILY_PREV_MTD AS (
        SELECT 
            TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE(),'YYYYMM') AS CURRENT_PERIOD,
            CHANNEL_GRP,
            SUBCHANNEL_GRP,
            PDS.FACT_PERIOD,
            PDS.PERIOD_KEY::VARCHAR AS PERIOD_KEY,
            PDS.PERIOD_KEY::VARCHAR AS WORKING_DT,
            DP.WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,
            PDS.SRC_SYSTEM,
            SUM(APE_GROSS_AMT) AS PREV_MTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT,
            SUM(APE_AMT) AS PREV_MTD_ISSUED_APE_NETT_AMT
        FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.GLD_REPORT.POLICY_DAILY_SMY PDS
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PERIOD DP
            ON PDS.PERIOD_KEY=DP.PERIOD_KEY
        WHERE FACT_PERIOD=TO_CHAR(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, CURRENT_DATE()), 'YYYYMM')
        GROUP BY ALL
)

    ,POLICY_DAILY_YTD AS (
        SELECT 
            TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE(),'YYYYMM') AS CURRENT_PERIOD,
            CHANNEL_GRP,
            SUBCHANNEL_GRP,
            PDS.FACT_PERIOD,
            PDS.PERIOD_KEY::VARCHAR AS PERIOD_KEY,
            PDS.PERIOD_KEY::VARCHAR AS WORKING_DT,
            DP.WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,
            PDS.SRC_SYSTEM,
            SUM(APE_GROSS_AMT) AS YTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT,
            SUM(APE_AMT) AS YTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT
        FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.GLD_REPORT.POLICY_DAILY_SMY PDS
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PERIOD DP
            ON PDS.PERIOD_KEY=DP.PERIOD_KEY
        WHERE FACT_PERIOD BETWEEN TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMM') AND TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE(),'YYYYMM')
        GROUP BY ALL
)

    ,POLICY_DAILY_YTD_LY_TEMP AS (
        SELECT 
            TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE(),'YYYYMM') AS CURRENT_PERIOD,
            CHANNEL_GRP,
            SUBCHANNEL_GRP,
            PDS.FACT_PERIOD,
            PDS.PERIOD_KEY::VARCHAR AS PERIOD_KEY,
            PDS.PERIOD_KEY::VARCHAR AS WORKING_DT,
            DP.WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,
            PDS.SRC_SYSTEM,
         
            SUM(APE_GROSS_AMT) AS APE_GROSS_AMT_YTD_LY_UP,
            SUM(APE_AMT) AS APE_NET_AMT_YTD_LY_UP,                 
            0 AS APE_GROSS_AMT_YTD_LY_DOWN, -- TBD
            0 AS APE_GROSS_AMT_YTD_LY_UP_MIN1, -- TBD
            0 AS APE_GROSS_AMT_YTD_LY_DOWN_MIN1, -- TBD            
            0 AS APE_NET_AMT_YTD_LY_DOWN, -- TBD 
            0 AS APE_NET_AMT_YTD_LY_UP_MIN1, -- TBD
            0 AS APE_NET_AMT_YTD_LY_DOWN_MIN1 -- TBD 
            
        FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.GLD_REPORT.POLICY_DAILY_SMY PDS
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PERIOD DP
            ON PDS.PERIOD_KEY=DP.PERIOD_KEY
        LEFT JOIN YTD_LY_PERIOD YLP
            ON PDS.PERIOD_KEY=YLP.PERIOD_KEY_CURRENT
        WHERE PDS.PERIOD_KEY BETWEEN DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', DATEADD('YEAR', -1, CURRENT_DATE())) AND DATE_YTD_LY
        GROUP BY ALL
)

    ,POLICY_DAILY_YTD_LY AS (
        SELECT 
            A.CURRENT_PERIOD,
            A.CHANNEL_GRP,
            A.SUBCHANNEL_GRP,
            A.FACT_PERIOD,
            A.PERIOD_KEY::VARCHAR AS PERIOD_KEY,
            A.PERIOD_KEY::VARCHAR AS WORKING_DT,
            A.WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,
            A.SRC_SYSTEM,    
    
        CASE WHEN B.ADJUST_WD_LY <> 0 THEN
            (COALESCE(APE_NET_AMT_YTD_LY_DOWN,0)+(COALESCE(APE_GROSS_AMT_YTD_LY_UP,0)-COALESCE(APE_GROSS_AMT_YTD_LY_DOWN,0))*(B.ADJUST_WD_LY-B.ADJUST_WD_LY_DOWN))
            -
            (COALESCE(APE_GROSS_AMT_YTD_LY_DOWN_MIN1,0)+(COALESCE(APE_GROSS_AMT_YTD_LY_UP_MIN1,0)-COALESCE(APE_GROSS_AMT_YTD_LY_DOWN_MIN1,0))*(B.ADJUST_WD_LY_MIN1-B.ADJUST_WD_LY_DOWN_MIN1))
            ELSE 0 END AS PREV_YTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT,   
            
        CASE 
            WHEN B.ADJUST_WD_LY <> 0 THEN
            (COALESCE(APE_NET_AMT_YTD_LY_DOWN,0)+(COALESCE(APE_NET_AMT_YTD_LY_UP,0)-COALESCE(APE_NET_AMT_YTD_LY_DOWN,0))*(B.ADJUST_WD_LY-B.ADJUST_WD_LY_DOWN))
                -
            (COALESCE(APE_NET_AMT_YTD_LY_DOWN_MIN1,0)+(COALESCE(APE_NET_AMT_YTD_LY_UP_MIN1,0)-COALESCE(APE_NET_AMT_YTD_LY_DOWN_MIN1,0))*(B.ADJUST_WD_LY_MIN1-B.ADJUST_WD_LY_DOWN_MIN1))
            ELSE 0 END AS PREV_YTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT,

    FROM POLICY_DAILY_YTD_LY_TEMP A
    LEFT JOIN ADJUST_WD B
        ON A.CURRENT_PERIOD=B.CURRENT_PERIOD
)

    ,ISSUED_SYSTEM_FINAL AS (
    SELECT
        CURRENT_PERIOD,
        CHANNEL_GRP,
        SUBCHANNEL_GRP,
        FACT_PERIOD,
        PERIOD_KEY,
        WORKING_DT,
        WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,
        SRC_SYSTEM,
    
        mtd.MTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT,
        mtd.MTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT,
        mtd.CASE_CNT_GROSS,
        mtd.CASE_CNT,
    
        budget.MTD_APE_PLAN_AMT,
        budget.MONTHLY_APE_PLAN_AMT,
    
        prev_mtd.PREV_MTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT,
        prev_mtd.PREV_MTD_ISSUED_APE_NETT_AMT,
    
        ytd.YTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT,
        ytd.YTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT,
    
        ytd_ly.PREV_YTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT,
        ytd_ly.PREV_YTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT
    
    FROM POLICY_DAILY_MTD mtd
    
    FULL OUTER JOIN FACT_APE_BUDGET budget USING (CURRENT_PERIOD,CHANNEL_GRP,SUBCHANNEL_GRP,FACT_PERIOD,PERIOD_KEY,WORKING_DT,WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,SRC_SYSTEM)
    FULL OUTER JOIN POLICY_DAILY_PREV_MTD prev_mtd USING (CURRENT_PERIOD,CHANNEL_GRP,SUBCHANNEL_GRP,FACT_PERIOD,PERIOD_KEY,WORKING_DT,WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,SRC_SYSTEM)
    FULL OUTER JOIN POLICY_DAILY_YTD ytd USING (CURRENT_PERIOD,CHANNEL_GRP,SUBCHANNEL_GRP,FACT_PERIOD,PERIOD_KEY,WORKING_DT,WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,SRC_SYSTEM)
    FULL OUTER JOIN POLICY_DAILY_YTD_LY ytd_ly USING (CURRENT_PERIOD,CHANNEL_GRP,SUBCHANNEL_GRP,FACT_PERIOD,PERIOD_KEY,WORKING_DT,WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,SRC_SYSTEM)
)

            PDS.SRC_SYSTEM,
            SUM(ISSUED_APE_AMT) AS YTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT,
            SUM(ISSUED_APE_AMT) AS YTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT
        FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.FACT_ACTUARY PDS
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PERIOD DP
            ON TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(PDS.MTH_KEY, 'YYYYMM')),'YYYYMMDD')=DP.PERIOD_KEY
        WHERE PDS.MTH_KEY BETWEEN TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMM') AND TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE(),'YYYYMM')
        GROUP BY ALL
)

    ,ISSUED_ACTUARY_YTD_LY AS (
         SELECT 
            TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE(),'YYYYMM') AS CURRENT_PERIOD,
            NULL AS CHANNEL_GRP,
            SUBCHANNEL_GRP,
            PDS.MTH_KEY AS FACT_PERIOD,
            TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(PDS.MTH_KEY, 'YYYYMM')), 'YYYYMMDD') AS PERIOD_KEY,
            TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(PDS.MTH_KEY, 'YYYYMM')), 'YYYYMMDD') AS WORKING_DT,
            DP.WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,
            PDS.SRC_SYSTEM,
            SUM(ISSUED_APE_AMT) AS PREV_YTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT,
            SUM(ISSUED_APE_AMT) AS PREV_YTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT
        FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.FACT_ACTUARY PDS
        LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PERIOD DP
            ON TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(PDS.MTH_KEY, 'YYYYMM')),'YYYYMMDD')=DP.PERIOD_KEY
        LEFT JOIN YTD_LY_PERIOD YLP
            ON PDS.MTH_KEY=YLP.MTH_KEY_YTD_LY             
        WHERE PDS.MTH_KEY BETWEEN TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE()),'YYYYMM')-100 AND MTH_KEY_YTD_LY
        GROUP BY ALL
)
    ,PREFINAL AS (
    SELECT
        CURRENT_PERIOD,
        CHANNEL_GRP,
        SUBCHANNEL_GRP,
        FACT_PERIOD,
        PERIOD_KEY,
        WORKING_DT,
        WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,
        SRC_SYSTEM,
        
        isf.MTD_APE_PLAN_AMT,
        isf.MONTHLY_APE_PLAN_AMT,        
        COALESCE(mtd_act.MTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT, isf.MTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT + mtd_man.MTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT) AS MTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT,
        COALESCE(mtd_act.MTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT, isf.MTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT + mtd_man.MTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT) AS MTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT,
        COALESCE(prev_mtd_act.PREV_MTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT, isf.PREV_MTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT + prev_mtd_man.PREV_MTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT) AS PREV_MTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT,
        COALESCE(prev_mtd_act.PREV_MTD_ISSUED_APE_NETT_AMT, isf.PREV_MTD_ISSUED_APE_NETT_AMT + prev_mtd_man.PREV_MTD_ISSUED_APE_NETT_AMT) AS PREV_MTD_ISSUED_APE_NETT_AMT,
        COALESCE(ytd_act.YTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT, isf.YTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT + ytd_man.YTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT) AS YTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT,
        COALESCE(ytd_act.YTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT, isf.YTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT + ytd_man.YTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT) AS YTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT,
        COALESCE(ytd_ly_act.PREV_YTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT, isf.PREV_YTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT + ytd_ly_man.PREV_YTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT) AS PREV_YTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT,
        COALESCE(ytd_ly_act.PREV_YTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT, isf.PREV_YTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT + ytd_ly_man.PREV_YTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT) AS PREV_YTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT,

        isf.CASE_CNT_GROSS,
        isf.CASE_CNT,
        mtd_man.ISSUED_CASE_CNT as ISSUED_CASE_CNT_MAN,
        mtd_man.PENDING_CASE_CNT,
        mtd_act.ISSUED_CASE_CNT as ISSUED_CASE_CNT_ACT     
        
    FROM ISSUED_SYSTEM_FINAL isf
    FULL OUTER JOIN ISSUED_MANUAL_MTD mtd_man USING (CURRENT_PERIOD,CHANNEL_GRP,SUBCHANNEL_GRP,FACT_PERIOD,PERIOD_KEY,WORKING_DT,WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,SRC_SYSTEM)
    FULL OUTER JOIN ISSUED_MANUAL_PREV_MTD prev_mtd_man USING (CURRENT_PERIOD,CHANNEL_GRP,SUBCHANNEL_GRP,FACT_PERIOD,PERIOD_KEY,WORKING_DT,WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,SRC_SYSTEM)
    FULL OUTER JOIN ISSUED_MANUAL_YTD ytd_man USING (CURRENT_PERIOD,CHANNEL_GRP,SUBCHANNEL_GRP,FACT_PERIOD,PERIOD_KEY,WORKING_DT,WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,SRC_SYSTEM)
    FULL OUTER JOIN ISSUED_MANUAL_YTD_LY ytd_ly_man USING (CURRENT_PERIOD,CHANNEL_GRP,SUBCHANNEL_GRP,FACT_PERIOD,PERIOD_KEY,WORKING_DT,WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,SRC_SYSTEM)
    FULL OUTER JOIN ISSUED_ACTUARY_MTD mtd_act USING (CURRENT_PERIOD,CHANNEL_GRP,SUBCHANNEL_GRP,FACT_PERIOD,PERIOD_KEY,WORKING_DT,WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,SRC_SYSTEM)
    FULL OUTER JOIN ISSUED_ACTUARY_PREV_MTD prev_mtd_act USING (CURRENT_PERIOD,CHANNEL_GRP,SUBCHANNEL_GRP,FACT_PERIOD,PERIOD_KEY,WORKING_DT,WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,SRC_SYSTEM)
    FULL OUTER JOIN ISSUED_ACTUARY_YTD ytd_act USING (CURRENT_PERIOD,CHANNEL_GRP,SUBCHANNEL_GRP,FACT_PERIOD,PERIOD_KEY,WORKING_DT,WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,SRC_SYSTEM)
    FULL OUTER JOIN ISSUED_ACTUARY_YTD_LY ytd_ly_act USING (CURRENT_PERIOD,CHANNEL_GRP,SUBCHANNEL_GRP,FACT_PERIOD,PERIOD_KEY,WORKING_DT,WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,SRC_SYSTEM)
)

    SELECT
        CURRENT_PERIOD,
        CHANNEL_GRP,
        SUBCHANNEL_GRP,
        FACT_PERIOD,
        PERIOD_KEY,
        WORKING_DT,
        WORK_DAY_OF_MTH,
        SRC_SYSTEM,
        MTD_APE_PLAN_AMT,
        MONTHLY_APE_PLAN_AMT,       
        MTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT,
        MTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT,
        PREV_MTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT,
        PREV_MTD_ISSUED_APE_NETT_AMT,
        YTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT,
        YTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT,
        PREV_YTD_ISSUED_APE_GROSS_AMT,
        PREV_YTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT,
        CASE_CNT_GROSS + ISSUED_CASE_CNT_MAN + ISSUED_CASE_CNT_ACT AS MTD_ISSUED_GROSS_CNT,
        CASE_CNT + ISSUED_CASE_CNT_MAN + ISSUED_CASE_CNT_ACT AS MTD_ISSUED_NET_CNT,
        MTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT + PENDING_CASE_CNT AS MTD_PENDING_APE_AMT,
        CASE_CNT + PENDING_CASE_CNT AS MTD_PENDING_CNT,
        
        MTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT / MTD_APE_PLAN_AMT AS MTD_ACHV_PCT,
        MTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT / MONTHLY_APE_PLAN_AMT AS MONTHLY_ACHV_PCT,
        (YTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT / PREV_YTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT) - 1 AS YTD_VS_PREV_YTD_AMT_PCT,
        (MTD_ISSUED_APE_NET_AMT / PREV_MTD_ISSUED_APE_NETT_AMT) - 1 AS MTD_VS_PREV_MTD_AMT_PCT,
        
    '20260916'::VARCHAR AS BATCH_DT,
    '207ed2a4-922e-49c4-b0c2-0ffda55b77c3'::VARCHAR AS DBT_INVOCATION_ID,
    'GLD_REPORT_INDODAILY_MTH_SMY'::VARCHAR AS JOB_ID,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()::TIMESTAMP_NTZ(6) AS LOAD_TS

    FROM PREFINAL

WITH POLICY_BASE AS (
    SELECT
        PDS.POLICY_NO,
        DMP.MDM_ID                 AS OWN_MDM_ID,
        PDS.PRODUCT_CD,
        PDS.PRODUCT_CHANNEL,
        DP.PRODUCT_CAT,
        DP.PRODUCT_SUB_CAT,
        DP.PRODUCT_NM_SUMM,
        DP.IS_SHARIA,
        DP.AMBITION_CD,
        PDS.SUM_INSURED_AMT,
        PDS.APE_AMT,
        PDS.IS_BIZCASE,
        PDS.IS_SUBMIT,
        PDS.IS_ISSUED AS POLICY_ACTIVE_STAT,
        PDS.IS_CANCELLED,
        PDS.IS_PENDING AS POLICY_PENDING_STAT,
        PDS.IS_COOLOFF AS POLICY_COOLOFF_STAT,
        FMP.EFF_DT,
        FMP.REINSTATE_EFF_DT,
        FMP.PYMT_MODE_CD,
        FMP.POLICY_CCY_CD,
        FMP.SRC_SYSTEM,
        FMP.PRODUCT_SUBCHANNEL
    FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.GLD_REPORT.POLICY_DAILY_SMY PDS
    LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.DIM_MDM_POL DMP
        ON PDS.POLICY_NO = DMP.POLICY_NO
        AND DMP.MDM_CUST_ROLE = 'OWN'
    LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PRODUCT.DIM_PRODUCT DP
        ON PDS.PRODUCT_CD = DP.PRODUCT_CD
    LEFT JOIN AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.FACT_MASTER_POL FMP
        ON PDS.POLICY_NO = FMP.POLICY_NO
),

TRAN_AGG AS (
    SELECT
        POLICY_NO,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TRAN_CD = 'SUR' THEN TRAN_AMT END) AS SURRENDER_AMT,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TRAN_CD = 'AW' AND TRAN_DT >= TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(DATEADD(day, -90, CURRENT_DATE()), 'YYYYMMDD'))
                 THEN TRAN_AMT END) AS WITHDRAWAL_AMT_LAST_3_MTH
    FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_FINACT.FACT_TRANSACTION
    GROUP BY POLICY_NO
),

CASE_AGG AS (
    SELECT
        POLICY_NO,
        MODE(CHANNEL) AS PREF_ACTUAL_COMM,
        MODE(CASE WHEN REQUEST_TYPE_CD = 'Complaint' THEN CHANNEL END) AS PREF_CPL_COMM,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN REQUEST_TYPE_CD = 'Complaint'
                   AND CREATED_DT >= DATEADD(day, -90, CURRENT_DATE())
              THEN REQUEST_ID END) AS COMPLAINT_LAST_3_MTH
    FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PARTY.FACT_PARTY_CASE
    GROUP BY POLICY_NO
),

RIDER_AGG AS (
    SELECT
        POLICY_NO,
        COUNT(PRODUCT_CD) AS RIDER_CNT
    FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_POLICY.FACT_POL_COVER
    GROUP BY POLICY_NO
),

BNF_AGG AS (
    SELECT
        POLICY_NO,
        COUNT(*) AS BNF_CNT
    FROM AMFS_DEV_DB.SLV_PARTY.DIM_BENEFICIARY
    GROUP BY POLICY_NO
),

POLICY_ENRICHED AS (
    SELECT
        PB.*,
        TA.SURRENDER_AMT,
        TA.WITHDRAWAL_AMT_LAST_3_MTH,
        CA.PREF_ACTUAL_COMM,
        CA.PREF_CPL_COMM,
        CA.COMPLAINT_LAST_3_MTH,
        COALESCE(RA.RIDER_CNT, 0) AS RIDER_CNT,
        COALESCE(BA.BNF_CNT, 0) AS BNF_CNT
    FROM POLICY_BASE PB
    LEFT JOIN TRAN_AGG TA ON PB.POLICY_NO = TA.POLICY_NO
    LEFT JOIN CASE_AGG CA ON PB.POLICY_NO = CA.POLICY_NO
    LEFT JOIN RIDER_AGG RA ON PB.POLICY_NO = RA.POLICY_NO
    LEFT JOIN BNF_AGG BA ON PB.POLICY_NO = BA.POLICY_NO
),

POLICY_AGG AS (
    SELECT
        OWN_MDM_ID,
        LISTAGG(DISTINCT POLICY_NO, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY POLICY_NO) AS POLICY_NO_LIST,
        MIN(EFF_DT) AS ORIGIN_POLICY_DT,
        MAX(REINSTATE_EFF_DT) AS LAPSE_HIST_REINSTATEMENT,
        SUM(POLICY_ACTIVE_STAT) AS ACTIVE_POLICY_CNT,
        SUM(POLICY_PENDING_STAT) AS PENDING_POLICY_CNT,
        SUM(POLICY_COOLOFF_STAT) AS COOLOFF_POLICY_CNT,
        MODE(CASE WHEN POLICY_ACTIVE_STAT = 1 THEN PYMT_MODE_CD END) AS PREF_PYMT_CODE,
        MODE(CASE WHEN POLICY_ACTIVE_STAT = 1 THEN POLICY_CCY_CD END) AS PREF_CCY,
        MODE(CASE WHEN POLICY_ACTIVE_STAT = 1 THEN PRODUCT_CHANNEL END) AS PREF_BUSINESS_CHANNEL,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN POLICY_ACTIVE_STAT = 1 THEN PRODUCT_CD END) AS PRODUCT_HOLDING_CNT,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN PRODUCT_CAT = 'HEALTH' AND POLICY_ACTIVE_STAT = 1 THEN POLICY_NO END) AS PRODUCT_HEALTH_CNT,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN PRODUCT_CAT = 'PROTECTION' AND POLICY_ACTIVE_STAT = 1 THEN POLICY_NO END) AS PRODUCT_PROTECTION_CNT,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN PRODUCT_CAT = 'RIDERS' AND POLICY_ACTIVE_STAT = 1 THEN POLICY_NO END) AS PRODUCT_RIDERS_CNT,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN PRODUCT_CAT = 'SAVING' AND POLICY_ACTIVE_STAT = 1 THEN POLICY_NO END) AS PRODUCT_SAVING_CNT,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN PRODUCT_CAT = 'UNIT LINKED' AND POLICY_ACTIVE_STAT = 1 THEN POLICY_NO END) AS PRODUCT_UNIT_LINKED_CNT,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN IS_SHARIA = 1 AND POLICY_ACTIVE_STAT = 1 THEN POLICY_NO END) AS SHARIA_CNT,
        LISTAGG(DISTINCT PRODUCT_NM_SUMM, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY PRODUCT_NM_SUMM) AS PRODUCT_NM_LIST,
        SUM(APE_AMT) AS TOT_APE_AMT_CUST,
        SUM(SURRENDER_AMT) AS SURRENDER_AMT_CUST,
        SUM(WITHDRAWAL_AMT_LAST_3_MTH) AS WITHDRAWAL_AMT_LAST_3_MTH,
        SUM(SUM_INSURED_AMT) AS SUM_INSURED_AMT,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN PRODUCT_CHANNEL IN ('IN BRANCH', 'INBRANCH') THEN POLICY_NO END) AS IN_BRANCH_CNT,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN PRODUCT_CHANNEL = 'TM' THEN POLICY_NO END) AS TM_CNT,
        CASE
            WHEN (
                (CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN PRODUCT_CHANNEL IN ('IN BRANCH', 'INBRANCH') THEN POLICY_NO END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
                (CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN PRODUCT_CHANNEL = 'TM' THEN POLICY_NO END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            ) >= 2 THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS IS_MULTI_BUSINESS,
        MODE(PREF_ACTUAL_COMM) AS PREF_ACTUAL_COMM,
        MODE(PREF_CPL_COMM) AS PREF_CPL_COMM,
        SUM(COMPLAINT_LAST_3_MTH) AS COMPLAINT_LAST_3_MTH,
        SUM(BNF_CNT) AS BNF_CNT,
        SUM(RIDER_CNT) AS RIDER_CNT
    FROM POLICY_ENRICHED
    GROUP BY OWN_MDM_ID
)
